clean_body: Friend – My debate with Darren Bailey just ended and I wanted you to hear about it directly from me. As I made clear tonight, this election couldn't be more consequential – after four years of Democrats delivering for working families, my extremist far-right opponent is plotting to ban fundamental rights and roll out the red carpet for Trump. His plan is to scare, insult, and lie his way into an office where he could reverse generations of progress. It's not going to happen on my watch. But we can't defeat Darren Bailey's agenda alone, so I have one question for you: Are you ready for the fight? Look, I'm biased here, but on one issue after another, we really have gotten big things done for Illinois. We enshrined reproductive rights into law; We raised the minimum wage to $15/hour; We expanded access to affordable health care; We balanced budgets and delivered $1.8 billion in tax relief; We launched the largest program in state history to rebuild roads, bridges, railways, and schools; We made it easier for families to pay for child care and college; We followed the science to fight COVID-19. While we fulfilled our promises to voters, Darren Bailey was ignoring working people across Illinois and sponsoring a ridiculous bill to kick Chicago out of the state. Now, as a candidate, he's pushing the most dangerous set of policies ever put forth by a nominee for governor. He wants to control women's bodies, forcing victims of rape and incest to carry pregnancies to term. He wants to eliminate the state minimum wage, cutting the income of hundreds of thousands of people. He wants to restrict voting rights, endorsed efforts to overthrow the 2020 election, and surrounds himself with people who stormed the Capitol on January 6. Darren Bailey's vision for our state is straight out of a horror movie, but we're not going to let him take power and roll back our rights. Not as long as we stand up and fight back over the next few weeks, so I'll ask one more time: Are you ready for the fight? It means so much to Juliana and me to have you by our side. **This is a BFD!!!** It’s a *massive* step towards making weed legal, safe, and pure for medicinal + recreational use by adults across the country.
And thanks to President Biden’s pardon, we’re also moving closer to expunging all marijuana records and releasing all those incarcerated for using the plant.
If you know me, Derek, you know I’ve always supported legal weed. When I heard President Biden would be in Pittsburgh a month ago, I knew that if I had a chance to sit down with him, I would use that opportunity to talk about the need to decriminalize marijuana. And that’s exactly what I did. 💪💪💪
Now one month later, President Biden is taking action — and I commend the president for taking this significant, necessary, and just step to right a wrong + better the lives of millions of Americans.
With your support, I’ll continue to be the LOUDEST (and tbh, probably the tallest) champion for legal weed + marijuana justice in the U.S. Senate. Plus, we’ll have the opportunity to win more major victories like this.
**[Let’s keep up our fight to legalize weed and end the racist War on Drugs — because it’s working. If you’re with me, chip in $5 or more to our people-powered campaign now.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221006-4?amount=5&refcode=em20221006-7602&refcode2=7602_434096_QMvZUN&akid=7602%2E434096%2EQMvZUN)**

_To be clear, the last time I smoked weed in earnest was at Burning Man in 1999._
Thanks, Derek. I’m so proud of this team today.

** Dear Patriots,

Under FL Statute 102.168, I had only ten days from the election certification within which to bring a Complaint to set aside the Election Results, as a result of misconduct, fraud or corruption. I brought the lawsuit and all five Defendants asked the Court (Judge Angela Dempsey) to dismiss the case for "Failure to State a Claim". I of course argued that I had stated a Claim. She is symbolic of the society we live in today. That if you are willing to degrade yourself, if you're willing to denigrate yourself, then our society will give you more.

**Is this the example we want to leave for our children?**

At BLEXIT, we believe families should be grounded in faith and honor and respect their children and protect their innocence.

My name is Candace Owens, co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation. BLEXIT focuses on educating minorities about the history of our great country, the principles of the Constitution, and the importance of self-reliance.

I've set a goal to raise $50,000 by the end of the month to show the next generation that they don't have to be like the Kardashians to be successful.

[**Can you support this critical mission with a gift of $25, $35, or even $50? Click here to donate today >>>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61527120:JzwbDxVRN:m:1:3334294963:BF5235EE4B9F52DDA798CCEF8078A544:r)

BLEXIT is bringing pro-America, pro-Family values to Black and minority communities through the work of our State Chapters.

Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the BLEXIT movement at the local level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

They demonstrate how people can escape the mentality of victimhood and empower others to take control of their destinies.

Just this summer, **BLEXIT-Fest in New Jersey introduced our message to over 400 people.** They had a variety of talented performers and speakers and created a memorable community celebration.

**BLEXIT chapter members from our Tampa, FL, and North Charleston, SC sites educated and cared for approximately 80 children** for six weeks during our full-day Summer Camp.

The children in our Tampa program even took a field trip to Legoland!

Now that school has started, these BLEXIT chapters are providing an after-school youth education program - Liberation Camp - for 80 children.

_BLEXIT 's Chapters are a huge part of our Back to School initiative_.

The BLEXIT Illinois Chapter **distributed over 400 school supplies** and BLEXIT merchandise in one of Chicago's most impoverished communities. The NY Chapter was fortunate to **give away 120 school supply kits as well as 40 book bags.**

BLEXIT Chapters are changing the narrative that surrounds America's minority communities.

These organizations are poisoning minority communities. They tell these bright young men and women they are victims of systematic repression and that their skin color is all that defines them.

But here's the ugly truth about other organizations who claim to serve the Black community:

Patriot,

My name is Amanda Adkins. I know you're busy, so I'll be short and to the point.

[**1) I 'm running in one of the most competitive House races in America, 2) Experts say this one race could determine who wins the House Majority, and 3**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zjohgc9q8fivdd6n8hs8apd8mfaaha19887c11mg_rp22sh2s8i66or5chj66o71c5h2bs)**[)](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zs50uhbr4ish90po3jse6qus96p1vne7dp8humm8_rp22sh2s8i66or5chj66o71c5h2bs)**[**With respect, I am humbly asking you to make a ten-dollar contribution to my campaign before Election Day as I just won the Republican primary**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z6r36g0dhpf9uq4bk38pu4mji99h361hlq1l5q2g_rp22sh2s8i66or5chj66o71c5h2bs)[**.**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z7dt3e3g8hduu7lmmu613t6m09rrq9pthv6457f8_rp22sh2s8i66or5chj66o71c5h2bs)

My opponent is a die-hard Liberal Democrat who walks in lockstep with Nancy Pelosi, Joe Biden, and ALL their loyal followers.

I, on the other hand, am a no-nonsense conservative with a record of servant leadership. I was the chairwoman of the Kansas Republican Party, I served on the Board of The Salvation Army, I'm a mother of two, and a come-in-early-and-stay-late businesswoman. _I 'm also endorsed by Ted Cruz, Mike Pompeo, Kevin McCarthy, Nikki Haley, Elise Stefanik, and Steve Scalise. _

**I know I can win this race.**

Republicans only need to gain four seats in the House to win back the Majority. [**And this is one of the most competitive House races in the ENTIRE country, so I really need the support of Republicans in every corner of our country.**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zjobl0qrebfijcqi8fec1hb9rdcc66hc5ji28jko_rp22sh2s8i66or5chj66o71c5h2bs)
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zd1cjt8c1gt2d009nivmaptnefa2qmghf9qvblu8_rp22sh2s8i66or5chj66o71c5h2bs)
**[**DONATE $10 NOW**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z1sjongb3v6s4dvvdd8i19mrk9sbo2t0acv2hqj0_rp22sh2s8i66or5chj66o71c5h2bs)**

Friend,

Would you believe me if I said that a mother watched videos of her daughter having sex with her boyfriend and picked which one her daughter looked best in to **sell?**

Because that’s exactly what happened — Kris Jenner watched AND hand-picked which sex tape her daughter Kim Kardashian would release!

**It is not an exaggeration to say that Hollywood is satanic.**
What could possibly be more satanic than a mother using her daughter's body to sell sex?

If that disgusts you, here’s where it gets worse. _It worked_. Kim Kardashian is a billionaire, and she’s still selling sex.

She is symbolic of the society we live in today. That if you are willing to degrade yourself, if you’re willing to denigrate yourself, then our society will give you more.

**Is this the example we want to leave for our children?**

At BLEXIT, we believe families should be grounded in faith and honor and respect their children and protect their innocence.

My name is Candace Owens, co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation. BLEXIT focuses on educating minorities about the history of our great country, the principles of the Constitution, and the importance of self-reliance.

I’ve set a goal to raise $50,000 by the end of the month to show the next generation that they don’t have to be like the Kardashians to be successful.

[**Can you support this critical mission with a gift of $10, $25, or even $50? Click here to donate today >>>**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zkmml41g9b5s8s346p3qimb2r01cvjninvudk02g_rp22sh2s8i66or5chj66p75cph2bs)

BLEXIT is bringing pro-America, pro-Family values to Black and minority communities through the work of our State Chapters.

Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the BLEXIT movement at the local level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

They demonstrate how people can escape the mentality of victimhood and empower others to take control of their destinies.

Just this summer, **BLEXIT-Fest in New Jersey introduced our message to over 400 people.** They had a variety of talented performers and speakers and created a memorable community celebration.

**BLEXIT chapter members from our Tampa, FL, and North Charleston, SC sites educated and cared for approximately 80 children** for six weeks during our full-day Summer Camp.

The children in our Tampa program even took a field trip to Legoland!

Now that school has started, these BLEXIT chapters are providing an after-school youth education program – Liberation Camp – for 80 children.

_BLEXIT’s Chapters are a huge part of our Back to School initiative_.

The BLEXIT Illinois Chapter **distributed over 400 school supplies** and BLEXIT merchandise in one of Chicago’s most impoverished communities. The NY Chapter was fortunate to **give away 120 school supply kits as well as 40 book bags.**

BLEXIT Chapters are changing the narrative that surrounds America’s minority communities.

[**We currently have 42 chapters across the US and more than 14,000 volunteers! You can help BLEXIT support our State Chapters by donating $10, $25, $50, or any other amount today. Click here to send your gift >>>**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z7uutiisgkjl65n8e3gst3j2adj8ajmmrf84c7vo_rp22sh2s8i66or5chj66p75cph2bs)

BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence reinforced by groups that market themselves as serving the Black community, such as Black Lives Matter, but in actuality, they destroy communities.

These organizations are poisoning minority communities. They tell these bright young men and women they are victims of systematic repression and that their skin color is all that defines them.

But here’s the ugly truth about other organizations who claim to serve the Black community:

* They claim to support Black communities. . . but they fan the flames of riots and violence that directly impact the lives of the people in those communities.

* They claim to fight for criminal justice reform. . . but they teach Black men and women to hate and disrespect police officers.

* They claim to be a non-profit group fighting for Black men and women. . . but they use donor funds to enrich themselves.

**These other organizations are destroying Black communities, dividing our country, and forcing a message of victimhood and hatred down the throats of minorities.**

BLEXIT is countering their hateful narrative, but we can’t do it alone, Friend. Can you donate to BLEXIT today and help us reach our goal of raising $50,000?

Join me in supporting Wisconsin Senator Ron Johnson today!](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zb8j2icufj1h7dtk7jesi0o59s3304q9qsht6ocg_rp22sh2s8i66or5chj66o77cdh2bs)** Thank you for considering this urgent request and for doing so much to help fight for America's future. | | | __**[You may not know me, so let me share my story.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61533363:J57PcxVNA:m:1:3253819041:A930A33B63A4318F21C6338901CFE5DB:r "You may not know me, so let me share my story.")**__
My name's Tiffany Smiley. I'm a mom of three, veteran's wife, and Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I'm running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent to bring **real change** to our country.

I married my high school sweetheart, Scotty, who was permanently blinded by a suicide bomber while serving in Iraq.

From there, I took on the federal government to fight for the rights that Scotty _**earned**_ as an active duty service member, and I _**won**_.

Fighting for Scotty inspired me to **advocate for _all_ veterans**, so I went to D.C. to speak up for those who put their lives on the line for our country.

Now, I need _your_ help to send me to D.C. to advocate for Washingtonians and all Americans who have been hurt by the terrible policies of Joe Biden and my Democrat opponent Patty Murray.

---
| | [HELP TIFFANY'S CAMPAIGN](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61533363:J57PcxVNA:m:1:3253819041:A930A33B63A4318F21C6338901CFE5DB:r "HELP TIFFANY’S CAMPAIGN")
---

Murray has been in office for _**three decades**_ and has done **nothing** to stop the rising crime, homelessness, and drug addiction crisis tearing my beloved home state apart.

I'm running for U.S. Senate because Americans deserve better than the failed leadership they've been stuck with for _years_.

It's time for a _**change**_ in D.C., and I'm the right person for the job.

The latest polls in Washington show that my opponent and I will be _**neck and neck**_ , and I'm getting nervous. We're _finally_ closing in on Murray, but I need your support to cross the finish line.

_**[Can you chip in any amount to help me take the lead to save Washington?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61533363:J57PcxVNA:m:1:3253819041:A930A33B63A4318F21C6338901CFE5DB:r "Can you chip in any amount to help me
take the lead to save Washington? ")**_

Your support will bring me closer to restoring the American dream from the U.S. Senate.

---

---

To victory,

Tiffany Smiley

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Tiffany Smiley

Friend,

This is Rudy. I'm humbly asking you to read my story and learn why I'm running to save the American Dream for the next generation.

_I was heartbroken the second I got the news of my friend and mentor Congresswoman Jackie Walorski & two of her young staff passing away in a tragic accident in early August._ **Her leadership and her dedication to serving others will never be forgotten.**

Jackie's drive and passion to ensure the citizens of Northern Indiana had a voice and true representation in Washington is one of the many reasons why I am proud to have stood beside her throughout the years.

**Today, I have a new opportunity as the new Republican nominee to carry on her legacy in the halls of Congress to continue her mission to bring true Hoosier common sense to D.C. I am honored to have the support of her family as I embark on this journey. **

**Look, Washington is missing leaders who are committed to protecting their local communities and fighting to restore America 's strength at home and abroad. As a business leader who grew up in this district, my neighbors in Indiana-02 do not have to worry about me putting politics ahead of their best interests.**

Today we are seeing Nancy Pelosi and her radical Left allies take our country down a road that will be unrecognizable if not stopped immediately. Every day we are seeing the Pelosi-Biden agenda place new burdens on hard-working American families.

This November is our final time to hold the Left accountable and redirect our country from falling further into the depths of socialism. The Democrats know the walls are closing in on them, and they're DUMPING millions into every race on the map. Unfortunately, new data shows the momentum shifting in the Dem's favor. **We need your support in the next 24 hours to help us claim victory! **
[****](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zjbm6bn0pahloo0vpc376g2ejk6q5lln3bnvia7g_rp22sh2s8i66or5chgm4oj1chh2bs)[**TAKE BACK THE HOUSE**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z0eh3pvddhp2l323i6jq922cc18se00svqev3lco_rp22sh2s8i66or5chgm4oj1chh2bs)
The election is less than 40 days away. I'm not usually the guy who asks for help, but I need your support ASAP to get my campaign off the ground so we can make Jackie proud and remove Nancy Pelosi from power this November.
**Help Boost My Campaign:**

[****](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zrtgqc6cjnfpb8kv6j4897p5iosebv84gcs7jq98_rp22sh2s8i66or5chgm4oj1chh2bs)[**CHIP IN $10**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z8a3n7kb0s307htr3q7iikun1rcmo2vu3noiom90_rp22sh2s8i66or5chgm4oj1chh2bs)
[****](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z9dgbneemutl3qd10tknhuepug05o5bl326g1uh0_rp22sh2s8i66or5chgm4oj1chh2bs)[**CHIP IN ANY AMOUNT**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zclqcogbu4h6ikv9ghe5nhpis9p7nvmmmvlpahbg_rp22sh2s8i66or5chgm4oj1chh2bs)

| | | Hi, friend, it’s Tiffany Smiley.

I wanted to take the time today to personally reach out and say _**thank you**_ for your generous contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate.

I can’t even begin to express my gratitude for your support.

Because of your help, I am closing in on my Democrat opponent Patty Murray _more_ and _more_ each day. The latest poll has me only 2 points behind!

_**We are doing something no one thought was possible in Washington state.**_ For decades, no Republican candidate has come _this close_ to taking down a Democrat incumbent.

This is truly a historic race, and I’m so glad to have you on the team!

By now you may have heard my story and why I’m taking the risk to run for United States Senate.

As a mom of three, _all_ I think about is my children’s future.

With Joe Biden and Patty Murray in charge, the American Dream for future generations is at risk.

**That’s my call to action. I simply refuse to sit idly by and accept this fate for my sons. **

With just a few weeks left until the General Election, I’m asking for your support _**just one more time. **_

_**[We’re so close to the finish line, I just need your help this last time to get me past it.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76125%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=V%2bsimqIP%2bsncKjty5AQP9w&sysid=1 "We’re so close to the finish line, I just

I hate to ask again because you’ve already shown me so much support, but I’d appreciate anything you can give today!

body:
Shameful. |
| | | | | [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001crFt9eCxNBlLg7GHiHAUvnPUe_dLl1HFTYzZnBRH_r3RBkn8nOEkjEwTSrYH_Ijt-D4h2YfeCMxa-O0BEr0bXBezNdHLqHksxk164Q_V39StfhdJjQjDPPH1KPOMjX7-Y-2fhLr7PQU=&c=4veGpivKLWVYqRtZtzoapo_bC302Y1OFIg3A-vgnhU3aQ2fLaWnj1Q==&ch=9Ed7gvnRax8lNgGOAWPc_D9GTC-75wciBEYEe79cNI1RbRuK70SPkA==)

My opponent is putting partisan politics over the victims of the 9/11 attack on the World Trade Center.

I will always fight for them and give them the care they deserve.
Thank you,

body:
What could possibly be more satanic than a mother using her daughter's body to sell sex?
[View this message in your browser](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zs5oa5ic7pakbji959jh4t79lqns3edp35i4s6po_rp22sh2s8i66or5chgmao71c1h238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuij79hnmer7acjjegon9crl6crn2ct66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2udonadpjcpo7ap1l6sp30slkcqrb7d73emo63c75m3inap9gmer7dddhmspb6c37q9o74oj6e2p6cs74mdhmfcjlcoobeddk6urm8phkc2p6co70mlhm1o5l64oracdle8iv0)
[](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zeu76fnv0mdjga2379sti326i5ol586e3438k43g_rp22sh2s8i66or5chgmao71c1h2bs)
Friend,

Would you believe me if I said that a mother watched videos of her daughter having sex with her boyfriend and picked which one her daughter looked best in to **sell?**

Because that's exactly what happened -- Kris Jenner watched AND hand-picked which sex tape her daughter Kim Kardashian would release!

**It is not an exaggeration to say that Hollywood is satanic.**
What could possibly be more satanic than a mother using her daughter's body to sell sex?

If that disgusts you, here's where it gets worse. _It worked_. Kim Kardashian is a billionaire, and she's still selling sex.

She is symbolic of the society we live in today. That if you are willing to degrade yourself, if you're willing to denigrate yourself, then our society will give you more.

**Is this the example we want to leave for our children?**

At BLEXIT, we believe families should be grounded in faith and honor and respect their children and protect their innocence.

My name is Candace Owens, co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation. BLEXIT focuses on educating minorities about the history of our great country, the principles of the Constitution, and the importance of self-reliance.

I've set a goal to raise $50,000 by the end of the month to show the next generation that they don't have to be like the Kardashians to be successful.

[**Can you support this critical mission with a gift of $10, $25, or even $50? Click here to donate today >>>**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z30cs79qlmgjv5ulfd7ouqnl8jchjpt95fna6tc8_rp22sh2s8i66or5chgmao71c1h2bs)

BLEXIT is bringing pro-America, pro-Family values to Black and minority communities through the work of our State Chapters.

Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the BLEXIT movement at the local level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

They demonstrate how people can escape the mentality of victimhood and empower others to take control of their destinies.

Just this summer, **BLEXIT-Fest in New Jersey introduced our message to over 400 people.** They had a variety of talented performers and speakers and created a memorable community celebration.

**BLEXIT chapter members from our Tampa, FL, and North Charleston, SC sites educated and cared for approximately 80 children** for six weeks during our full-day Summer Camp.

The children in our Tampa program even took a field trip to Legoland!

Now that school has started, these BLEXIT chapters are providing an after-school youth education program - Liberation Camp - for 80 children.

_BLEXIT 's Chapters are a huge part of our Back to School initiative_.

The BLEXIT Illinois Chapter **distributed over 400 school supplies** and BLEXIT merchandise in one of Chicago's most impoverished communities. The NY Chapter was fortunate to **give away 120 school supply kits as well as 40 book bags.**

BLEXIT Chapters are changing the narrative that surrounds America's minority communities.

[**We currently have 42 chapters across the US and more than 14,000 volunteers! You can help BLEXIT support our State Chapters by donating $10, $25, $50, or any other amount today. Click here to send your gift >>>**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zbmmg8c5ie0e3j4059p2n4sh1cutu76eh8h4960o_rp22sh2s8i66or5chgmao71c1h2bs)

BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence reinforced by groups that market themselves as serving the Black community, such as Black Lives Matter, but in actuality, they destroy communities.

These organizations are poisoning minority communities. They tell these bright young men and women they are victims of systematic repression and that their skin color is all that defines them.

But here's the ugly truth about other organizations who claim to serve the Black community:

* They claim to support Black communities. . . but they fan the flames of riots and violence that directly impact the lives of the people in those communities.

* They claim to fight for criminal justice reform. . . but they teach Black men and women to hate and disrespect police officers.

* They claim to be a non-profit group fighting for Black men and women. . . but they use donor funds to enrich themselves.

**These other organizations are destroying Black communities, dividing our country, and forcing a message of victimhood and hatred down the throats of minorities.**

BLEXIT is countering their hateful narrative, but we can't do it alone, Friend. Can you donate to BLEXIT today and help us reach our goal of raising $50,000?

# Huffines Liberty Foundation
**Huffines Liberty Foundation Newsletter #1** _**From our President, Don Huffines:**_ Hello Patriots,We're facing tremendous problems right here in Texas. Over the last few weeks, we've heard stories about drag shows meant for children, government overreach by the Federal government, massive price inflation, and many others. A significant reason for our problems is the ever-growing power and government intrusion in our daily lives.Leftist radicals penetrated many parts of the local, state, and federal government. From cradle to early adulthood, government schools poison our children's brains with radical ideas, and professors in Texas universities convince young adults to abandon morals and denounce hard work. We must push back with healthy, godly values and reduce the ever-growing expansion of top-down mandates. These problems are far broader than education - education is just one of the most obvious.The Huffines Liberty Foundation will educate and empower Texans to hold their political representatives accountable. I am very proud to launch this initiative and look forward to promoting liberty, prosperity, and virtue.\- Don Huffines **News:** Huffines Liberty Foundation started this summer to advance the blessings of liberty for all Texans. We look forward to educating the public on how we can build a better Texas and get the government out of the way of prosperity. The future of Texas is up to all of us.Our first two policy initiatives are property tax relief and border security. We will be releasing comprehensive policy papers on these issues with clear solutions for our elected office holders. Please stay informed in our next newsletter. Rising home values create rising tax burdens, and uncontrolled government spending hurts everyone in Texas - especially working families. While we see unprecedented development in our great state, we also see reckless government tax-and-spend strategies. Government revenue keeps increasing, but so do property tax rates.Municipalities across Texas raise rates because the natural tendency of government is to grow government. An engaged and educated citizenry is the best check on the expansion of government and its waste.Property tax relief and our upcoming roadmaps to eliminating property tax will help solve the burdens on Texans and pave the way for liberty. This set of policies will mean Texans get to keep a little bit more of their hard-earned money.Texas's southern border is in crisis. We will work to convince Texas leaders to declare an invasion and to follow through with deporting all illegal aliens in the state. In the past, Texas treated the deluge of people and drugs as an immigration and law enforcement issue. By declaring an invasion, our state receives additional powers to enforce border security and not just Federal immigration law. The cartels and human smugglers regularly flaunt Federal laws. A declared invasion allows us to treat these groups like foreign threats. Texans cannot wait around for the Federal government any longer.If you want to support the Huffines Liberty Foundation, click the link here: [Help Advance the Cause of Liberty!](https://dhcampaign.cmail20.com/t/t-l-adyfg-yuddtktydi-r/) The Huffines Liberty Foundation is a 501(c)(3) charitable organization, and charitable contributions are tax-deductible for income, gift, and estate taxes. Our federal tax identification number is 88-1883484 Also, did you see Don's latest article in Texas Scorecard? In the piece, Don argues why Texas Universities should be supporting Texans, not members of the Chinese Communist Party.[https://texasscorecard.com/commentary/keep-texas-universities-texan-not-communist/](https://dhcampaign.cmail20.com/t/t-l-adyfg-yuddtktydi-y/) [](https://dhcampaign.cmail20.com/t/t-l-adyfg-yuddtktydi-j/) | Huffines Liberty Foundation www.HuffinesLiberty.com [Preferences](https://dhcampaign.updatemyprofile.com/t-adyfg-17329976-yuddtktydi-k) | [Unsubscribe](https://dhcampaign.cmail20.com/t/t-u-adyfg-yuddtktydi-u/)

Truly, this means the world to me

| |
---
| | | Hi, friend, it’s Tiffany Smiley.

I wanted to take the time today to personally reach out and say _**thank you**_ for your generous contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate.

I can’t even begin to express my gratitude for your support.

Because of your help, I am closing in on my Democrat opponent Patty Murray _more_ and _more_ each day. The latest poll has me only 2 points behind!

_**We are doing something no one thought was possible in Washington state.**_ For decades, no Republican candidate has come _this close_ to taking down a Democrat incumbent.

This is truly a historic race, and I’m so glad to have you on the team!

By now you may have heard my story and why I’m taking the risk to run for United States Senate.

As a mom of three, _all_ I think about is my children’s future.

With Joe Biden and Patty Murray in charge, the American Dream for future generations is at risk.

**That’s my call to action. I simply refuse to sit idly by and accept this fate for my sons. **

With just a few weeks left until the General Election, I’m asking for your support _**just one more time. **_

_**[We’re so close to the finish line, I just need your help this last time to get me past it.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45492%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8BWRgV7OVAgYDBnpeqvqNA&sysid=1 "We’re so close to the finish line, I just
need your help this last time to get me past it. ")**_

I hate to ask again because you’ve already shown me so much support, but I’d appreciate anything you can give today!

---

Humbly,

Tiffany Smiley

Tiffany Smiley is _**CLOSING IN**_ on her Democrat opponent Patty Murray for the race for Senate in Washington!
---
| | | [HELP TIFFANY TAKE THE LEAD](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45406%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=zkQVb%2bz1CnmFsKcyiSb1%2bA&sysid=1 "HELP TIFFANY TAKE THE LEAD")
---

The entire nation is watching and waiting to see if Tiffany can take down a 30-year career politician to bring real change to the Pacific Northwest.

With the polls nearly _neck and neck,_ there’s no time left to waste. We need grassroots supporters from every corner of the country to help boost Tiffany’s momentum heading into November.

The time is NOW to change the trajectory of our country. Supporting Tiffany is supporting the future of our nation.
_**[Be a part of history by chipping in to support Tiffany today!](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45407%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=D%2foNdpL3Ddqm%2bGO6HiGVRw&sysid=1 "Be a part of history by chipping in to
support Tiffany today! ")**_

---

---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45409%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=If9c5jdugI2uZXWbTJHI9Q&sysid=1 "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help
in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45400%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=EPUiLRD5MlwziJ0PyUEoJg&sysid=1 "Step up now!")**_

We're nearly two weeks away from the October 24th voter registration deadline, ! Here's your reminder to double check your voting status, especially if you've recently moved or changed your last name.
Here's what you need to know as we approach Election Day in the Commonwealth:
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/50634650776B4D726A633761704E516641433431795867792F46434934526B634347704B7A4346314159526B614F4D6C424B376D353179746A6B37735351336D/editor_images/Image%20%2813%29.jpeg]
Don't Forget These Important Dates
October 24, 2022: Last day to REGISTER before the November election
November 1, 2022: Last day to apply for a mail-in or civilian absentee ballot
November 8, 2022: Election Day! Last day for County Boards of Elections to receive vote by mail and civilian absentee ballots (must be received by 8:00 P.M.)
Latest Headlines
Max Baer, Pennsylvania Supreme Court’s chief justice, dies.
Max Baer, the chief justice of the Pennsylvania Supreme Court, has died only months before he was set to retire, the court confirmed Saturday. He was 74.
Baer died overnight at his home near Pittsburgh, the court said in a news release. The court didn’t give a reason for his death but called his “sudden passing” a “tremendous loss for the court and all of Pennsylvania.”
The court said Justice Debra Todd now becomes chief justice “as the justice of longest and continuous service on the court.” She is the first female chief justice in the commonwealth’s history, a court spokesperson confirmed. Read more >> [https://www.delcotimes.com/2022/10/02/max-baer-pennsylvania-supreme-courts-chief-justice-dies/]
Early voting in Pennsylvania is different than other states. Here's what you need to know
Unlike some other states, where voters can cast their ballot at a voting center days before an election, early voting in Pennsylvania only involves a mail ballot. Read more >> [https://www.goerie.com/story/news/politics/2022/10/04/early-voting-pennsylvania-everything-you-need-to-know-general-election/69486541007/]
A Quick Reminder to PA Students
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/544D4F636B6E30326A33375138554C56723873714A6644334D506553535375633872332B7659474D78576F373957726973686C5177394D5032364E72626D3179/editor_images/Untitled%20%283%29.png]
All students must be registered in the county they plan to vote in by October 8. Whether voting on campus or back home, students MUST reside in their county for a full month before they are able to vote.
Pass it on!

PA Bus Tour [https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/50634650776B4D726A633761704E516641433431795867792F46434934526B634347704B7A4346314159526B614F4D6C424B376D353179746A6B37735351336D/editor_images/Image%20%289%29%20%281%29.jpeg]

Team —

I’m reaching out today to ask you to support my husband, John, so he can flip TX-23. Please, give me a chance to explain why this is so important. (If you don’t need an explanation, click here to rush a contribution now!) [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-lira?refcode=EM_FR_221007michelle_EOM_TL_FL_10_NG_N_logo&amount=3]

I’ve watched John on the campaign trail for a year now. And it hasn’t always been easy. His opponent has a ton of money and could drop millions in attack ads against him at any moment.

But John has never let that scare him. In fact, it makes him push even harder. And with just a few weeks until Election Day — he is going nonstop.
It’s clear that TX-23 deserves a true representative in Washington. So, how can you help?

John needs to be prepared for any attacks that come against him this month, and the best way to do that is to make sure he hits his fundraising goal before tomorrow at midnight. We can’t afford to fall short. So, what do you say?

If you are able, will you make a $3 donation to John’s campaign? We need everyone to chip in if we are going to reach our next goal in time. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-lira?refcode=EM_FR_221007michelle_EOM_TL_FL_10_NG_N_logo&amount=25]

Thank you so much,

Michelle

body:
|
---

Hey team - I wanted to provide you with a rundown of what happened during the redistricting process in Alabama and why our team at the National Redistricting Foundation, our 501(c)(3) affiliate, jumped in to take action.
**Official Alabama Gerrymandering Timeline:**
* August 2021 -- The 2020 Census data shows that Black Alabamians now compose more than 27 percent of the state’s population and nearly 26 percent of the state’s voting age population.
* November 2021 -- Governor Ivey signed Alabama’s proposed maps into law, including a congressional map that denied Alabama’s growing Black communities an opportunity to elect candidates of their choice.
* November 2021 -- The lawsuit _Caster v. Merrill_ , supported by the NRF, was consolidated with two other cases, including _Milligan_ , a case brought by NAACP LDF and the ACLU.
* January 2022 -- The district court ordered that the state redraw its map in compliance with the VRA before the 2022 election.
* January 2022 -- Alabama immediately appealed the trial court’s decision to the U.S. Supreme Court. In a 5-4 decision, the Court issued a stay blocking the remedial map-drawing process.
* October 2022 -- The U.S. Supreme Court heard oral arguments in _Merrill v. Milligan_ on the second day of the Court’s 2022-2023 Term.

---
The U.S. Supreme Court heard oral arguments about Alabama's congressional district plan on Tuesday. **Alabama argued for the narrowing of the historic Voting Rights Act, established to safeguard minority voters and designed to prevent maps exactly like the racially discriminatory map they enacted.**

While we fight for fair congressional districts in Alabama, Republicans view this as a chance to dilute minority votes through gerrymandering and eliminating our ability to hold them accountable with the Voting Rights Act. **A.G. clean_body: | Hey team - I wanted to provide you with a rundown of what happened during the redistricting process in Alabama and why our team at the National Redistricting Foundation, our 501(c)(3) affiliate, jumped in to take action. Official Alabama Gerrymandering Timeline: August 2021 -- The 2020 Census data shows that Black Alabamians now compose more than 27 percent of the state’s population and nearly 26 percent of the state’s voting age population. November 2021 -- Governor Ivey signed Alabama’s proposed maps into law, including a congressional map that denied Alabama’s growing Black communities an opportunity to elect candidates of their choice. November 2021 -- The lawsuit Caster v. Merrill , supported by the NRF, was consolidated with two other cases, including Milligan , a case brought by NAACP LDF and the ACLU. January 2022 -- The district court ordered that the state redraw its map in compliance with the VRA before the 2022 election. January 2022 -- Alabama immediately appealed the trial court’s decision to the U.S. Supreme Court. In a 5-4 decision, the Court issued a stay blocking the remedial map-drawing process. October 2022 -- The U.S. Supreme Court heard oral arguments in Merrill v. Milligan on the second day of the Court’s 2022-2023 Term. The U.S. Supreme Court heard oral arguments about Alabama's congressional district plan on Tuesday. Alabama argued for the narrowing of the historic Voting Rights Act, established to safeguard minority voters and designed to prevent maps exactly like the racially discriminatory map they enacted. 19 miles to go, friend. We're in the final stretch.
As I'm writing you this email, I've been traveling from one rally to the next and just got back on the campaign bus. With only 32 days left before Election Day, I'm visiting every single corner of Florida – from the Panhandle to the Keys.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52136319/371374594/1789453275?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1788-bu-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1OWNhMzg4NC00YzQ2LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ean_SZ4yVuEORMv_jMn1_Y3Ne47iUv4jlcY9npHb0NE=)
I've had a lot of long days and sleepless nights on my tour across Florida, so people often ask me what keeps me going.
Here's what I tell them: I think about the hardworking families like mine who deserve a leader that understands their lives, their struggles and their dreams. I think about our country's need to expand our Democratic Senate majority to protect our democracy.
And, in the background of all of this, I hear my mother's voice in my head telling me, "Never tire of doing good, Val."
That's what energizes me as I travel to all 67 counties of Florida to surge ahead in this race. I know winning this race will make a meaningful difference for Florida – and for our country – but polls show me neck and neck with Marco Rubio right now.
That's why I'm asking for your support in the final stretch of my campaign. Unlike Marco Rubio, my average donation is just $29.04, so I rely on people like you to help me fund voter outreach and move forward in these final few weeks.
I'm about to hop off the bus at my next campaign event, so I have to ask: If you believe in this campaign and want to help me defend our Democratic Senate majority, will you split a $3 donation today between my campaign and Maggie Hassan's? clean_body: We’re back with updates from the past few weeks and resources to ensure you make your voice heard next month. | | | Tomorrow marks exactly one month from the midterm elections! 🗳️ We’re in the home stretch, and we cannot afford to slow down for even a moment. With these last few weeks, we’ve got to work harder than ever before. That includes getting more organizers on the ground, more voters contacted, and more campaigns the resources they need. So, before you read on, can you show your commitment to electing Democrats in this upcoming election by donating $25 today? | | | We really appreciate your support, Peter. Now onto your weekly Team Joe Newsletter! → Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson In past newsletters, we’ve updated you on Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson’s nomination and confirmation, and we’re thrilled about her investiture last week. Check out this picture below of President Biden with our newest Supreme Court Justice: Get Ready to Vote No matter where you live, there’s a simple way for you to get involved in protecting our democracy this November: by voting! To make sure you’re ready to cast your ballot, we wanted to share this easy-to-read graphic for you to pass along to your friends and family as they, too, prepare to vote in this year’s elections. Check it out: | | Still have questions? Head over to IWillVote.com to get the answers to all your voting questions. | | Make Calls with Democrats The few weeks we have before Election Day are critical, and one of the most important actions we can take is talking with voters. This Saturday, we’ll be having conversations with voters in Wisconsin, Georgia, and North Carolina! Having conversations over the phone is one of the most effective ways to reach voters for key races this midterm election. If you’d like to support our work and the work of Democrats nationwide in the coming weeks, sign up for Saturday’s Phone Bank. | | New Sticker Alert 🚨 With just 32 days until the election, now is the time to start planning your trip to the ballot box, and what better way to do that than with this sticker? Perfect for your laptop, shirt, or backpack, this sticker is a great way to rally your friends, family, and community to vote as well as show your support for Democrats ahead of Election Day. | | Picking Up the Pace Peter -- we’ll make this section brief. | | Peter,

Tim Walz has failed every Minnesotan in fulfilling the most important job of an elected official: ensuring public safety. The men and women who protect our communities daily understand this, and that’s why they are supporting my candidacy. I’m honored to have the endorsement of the MPPOA and police officers across our state. When we win on November 8th, we’ll immediately work together to bring safe streets back to our neighborhoods. [Please watch the full endorsement press conference by clicking the thumbnail below:](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=368b4f78ed&e=33b11688c1)

---
| Violent crime has [increased 36%](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=a1ceb607fb&e=33b11688c1) in Minnesota since 2018, the year Governor Walz was elected. Also, for the first time in recent history, Minnesota’s violent crime rate is [higher than the national average.](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=5ca65dc3a9&e=33b11688c1) Further, from the year prior to Tim Walz taking office until the most recent crime report data, the [following has occurred in Minnesota:](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=e477a72cfd&e=33b11688c1)
* Murders have **increased 93%,** from 104 to 201.
* There were **779 carjackings in 2021** , the first year that data was recorded. They are counted separately from motor vehicle thefts. **Carjackings weren't previously reported as a separate statistic because they were so rare.**
* Aggravated assaults have **increased 63%, **from 6,693 to 10,967.
* Motor vehicle thefts have **increased 47%,** from 10,082 to 14,829, which is the **highest number recorded in two decades in our state.**
* Robberies have **increased 35%,** from 2,943 to 3,991.

We need new leadership in Minnesota - and I'm proud to have the backing of the Minnesota Police and Peace Officers Association. Together, and with them by our side, we will Heal Minnesota from the failed policies of Tim Walz.
---
|
---
|
In Freedom,

Dr. Scott Jensen
Republican Candidate for Governor - Minnesota

name: Adam Laxalt
subject: Where I come from
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Laxalt for Senate
body:
| |
---
| | | Hi, I'm Adam Laxalt, and this is my story.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61524456:JNCiqxVN7:m:1:3339843426:146AC3320A68FD86C5D665EEE0962D12:r "Adam 1")
---

I didn't know who my father was. I was born to a single mother in the 1970s. She was in her early 20s, had no college degree, and faced enormous pressure to not bring me into this world. But through faith, she chose to give me the chance to live, and I'll be forever grateful for that opportunity.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61524456:JNCiqxVN7:m:1:3339843426:146AC3320A68FD86C5D665EEE0962D12:r "Adam 2")
---

Although my childhood wasn't always easy, my experiences shaped me into the person I am today. I learned the power of faith and the importance of family and community. Without these things, there is no way I could've accomplished everything that I have.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61524456:JNCiqxVN7:m:1:3339843426:146AC3320A68FD86C5D665EEE0962D12:r "Adam 3")
---

After 9/11 attacks, I joined the US Navy - I always knew I wanted to serve my country, but after that date, I knew I needed to act. As a Naval Officer and Iraq Veteran, I served in detainee operations and assisted in the detention and prosecution of more than 20,000 detainees.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61524456:JNCiqxVN7:m:1:3339843426:146AC3320A68FD86C5D665EEE0962D12:r "Adam 4")
---

Nothing made me prouder than keeping my fellow Americans safe by assisting with the prosecution of thousands of war criminals and terrorists.

After finishing my active duty service, I decided to get married and start my family. But I knew I wasn't done serving and protecting our country. In 2015, I became Nevada's Attorney General, where I fought against President Obama by suing over federal overreach. I fought for the Constitution.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61524456:JNCiqxVN7:m:1:3339843426:146AC3320A68FD86C5D665EEE0962D12:r "Adam 5")
---

Today I live in Reno with my wife, Jaime, and four kids. They're the reason I'm running for US Senate.

I believe our country is fighting a battle between good and evil, and right now it seems the wrong side is winning. But I believe America is worth saving, and I know you do too.

_**[That's why I'm asking you to join my team and fight with me to restore conservative leadership in Washington.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61524456:JNCiqxVN7:m:1:3339843426:146AC3320A68FD86C5D665EEE0962D12:r "That’s why I’m asking you to join my team and fight with me to restore conservative leadership in
Washington.")**_ Together we can take this country back, but we must act now. Please, step up now before it's too late.

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM LAXALT](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61524456:JNCiqxVN7:m:1:3339843426:146AC3320A68FD86C5D665EEE0962D12:r "JOIN TEAM LAXALT")
---

I know with your support, we can save this country we both love so much.

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Adam Laxalt

---
| |

---

Hello,
**The attacks from Chuck Grassley keep coming.**
_“The most liberal nominee in Iowa Senate history”
“Radical”
“Socialist”_
Gotta love it!
Chuck Grassley doesn’t know what to say about me. He’s never faced an opponent like me before. I’m his political nightmare, so he’s just throwing cow pies at the wall and hoping something sticks.
Calling me “radical” is laughable when Chuck Grassley supports a complete ban on abortion and letting literally anyone buy an AR-15 without even a background check. **But there’s one attack that I absolutely won’t take lying down, and that’s Chuck Grassley’s attacking me for serving our country for 36 years in the U.S. Navy.**
Grassley is now trying to say that because I enlisted in the military at age 19, because my deployments meant that my family had to move from state-to-state and country-to-country... that I’m not an Iowan anymore.
Chuck Grassley wants to pretend that I wasn’t raised in rural, northwest Iowa. He ignores the enormous sacrifices that my family – my wife and my kids – made to allow me to serve in the Navy.
**Grassley’s attacks denigrate every servicemember and every military family that has to pack up, change schools, say goodbye to friends, spend holidays away from each other, and be absent from life’s big events like weddings and the birth of a child.**
**And if Chuck Grassley thinks that I will stand silent while he says that every Iowan who puts on our country’s uniform stops being an Iowan... he’s delusional.**
These are the kinds of attacks I’m up against. Nasty stuff from Chuck Grassley, Mitch McConnell, and the Fox ‘Entertainment’ News propaganda network.
There’s one reason why: The GOP is scared. They’ve seen the polls, and they know that if we defeat Grassley and turn Iowa blue this November, Democrats are guaranteed to maintain our Senate majority.
**In order to fight back, we need to raise another $100,000 before our most important fundraising deadline of the campaign yet, but the only way we’ll hit this huge goal and send Grassley packing is if grassroots donors like you give right now:**

Since the GOP proposed their nationwide abortion ban, health care activists and groups alike have been ringing the alarm on how legislation like this could be detrimental to women across our country. But this newly released memo just put these dangerous effects into perspective. Studies show that a nationwide GOP abortion ban may increase maternal deaths by 24%, with Black women seeing the highest increase in maternal deaths at 39%. Without the protections of Roe v. Wade and our Democratic majority on the line this November , this could become our reality. But, Peter, I’m not going to back down without a fight. That’s why I stood with my colleagues outside of our Capitol Building and called out these findings for all to hear. Democrats in Congress are focused on supporting maternal health through expanding Medicaid, ACA subsidies, and more. But to continue our work, we need your help. = = We already see the devastating effects of restrictive abortion bans right here in Ohio. Recent court findings show at least two minors who were sexually assaulted were forced to leave Ohio to receive treatment, on top of countless others. But the women of Ohio are ready to fight back. Ohio saw the second-highest jump in voter registration in the weeks after Roe v. Wade was overturned. With a 7% increase, women in Ohio make up nearly 54% of all registered voters. Hi, friend. It's Val Demings.
I don't get downtime that often, but when I do, my husband, Jerry, and I like to go through our old photo albums. We laugh at the horribly out-of-style outfits, get teary at how little our three sons once were and take a moment to acknowledge where we started versus where we are now.
Friend, only in America could our family have achieved this level of opportunity. I'm the Black daughter of a maid and a janitor who grew up in the 1960s South, and I have a real chance at becoming Florida’s next senator.

I owe a large part of my success to Jerry, who has been my partner in crime fighting for more than three decades – but I also owe immense gratitude to grassroots supporters like you.
Thanks to this massive grassroots team, we've been able to outraise Rubio _every single quarter_ and make this race competitive _._ But we're in danger of falling short of our midnight fundraising goal – and we're running out of time to close the gap.

If I'm honest, I'm worried that missing this goal means losing our momentum to flip Florida blue – because I'm already being outspent in key areas of the state and the latest polling has us slipping.
**So please – to help me close the 1-point gap in the polls and defeat my anti-choice, pro-Trump opponent, Marco Rubio – will you donate $5 to my campaign for Senate now? Here's the best link: [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/vd_senate-fr-email-octobermatch](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52126319/371335057/1022809660?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4681-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNWQ5ZDJmMy0zZjQ2LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XCcLbAFuzM_Dho2nYegN5riyrcj4JjLLK0hWssAQlkc=)**
Thank you for making history with me.

Val Demings

body:
| | | Peter, America has fallen.
---
How did we get here? When I was growing up, I longed for the American Dream. I was raised in an environment that was rooted in faith, family, and freedom. That was the norm back then. Peter, will you join me in praying for restoration in our nation? I am heartbroken at the America I see today. It is almost unrecognizable to me. That is why I am calling on you to help me elect like-minded, God-fearing patriots across the nation.
---

| | So, how did we get here? We've allowed the Radical Left to control the narrative and work towards a Godless nation. _A nation where the power of prayer is stripped away from our schools. _ _A nation where our children are taught that police officers are villains._ _A nation where the radical Left and their media partners are allowed to control the narrative._ The longer we allow this to happen, the further America descends into a Godless abyss.
---

This November, it is our responsibility to elect faith-based conservatives to bring back the America we want our children and grandchildren to grow up in. **[Again, Peter, I am calling on you to stand with me and support like-minded, God-fearing patriots in every corner of the nation.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61542936:64KxgxVYN:m:1:3317145305:453B941916A6C4AF975E12C99AC7B0A6:r)** Thank you,

I was so proud this summer when we passed the most significant federal gun safety legislation in nearly three decades. But we know the gun lobby will try to undo our progress. They have their eye on November to try to stage their comeback – and they're determined to try and defeat me. body:
Fellow Conservative:

Like you, we also have high hopes for November. But as you know, conservatives need to be thinking past the mid-terms, too.
That's where CPI comes in.
In January, dozens of new conservative members of the House and Senate are going to come to Washington with targets on their backs.
Establishment leaders, lobbyists, and Beltway insiders will all get to work to turn America First candidates into Swamp creatures. Wolves will pose as shepherds, offering guidance and friendship. They'll offer fundraising help, hiring advice, and the "right connections."
CPI's Staffing and Training Services department is the antidote to this political poison.
Our team of principled, savvy Hill veterans will be there for newly elected conservative members every step of the way: from their election to their swearing-in and beyond.
CPI's training courses are the most rigorous and sought-after in Washington. We teach staff what party leaders don't want them to know: the intricacies of policy, legislative and communications strategy, and also how to use House and Senate rules to fight back against the
Establishment. We work hand-in-glove with new members and chiefs of staff to hire their teams - from gathering resumes to interviewing to final decisions.
Please help us ramp up our staffing preparations with a tax-deductible gift to CPI today!
As 2021 freshman Rep. Byron Donalds (FL) said:
"They didn't just send me some resumes of potential staff members and wish me well. You have to understand: CPI interviews and vets young conservatives all year round to identify and then recommend the best, smartest, and toughest staff."

We are changing the way conservative Representatives and Senators work - honing, coordinating, amplifying. Many members now send their entire staff over to CPI for training retreats.
And we know that this year, CPI's Staffing and Training Services will be more important than ever. The new Congress will have more anti-establishment conservative freshman members. The hundreds of staffers that get hired in personal and committee offices will help determine the
trajectory of Congress for a generation.
With your help, CPI will be ready.
We have increased the size and scope of our operations to meet the growing demand. We are redoubling our training, recruitment, and vetting work so that the most conservative freshman class of new members in history will also be the best prepared. With your help, we will
keep working, keep teaching, and keep partnering with conservatives in Washington and across the country. America's emerging conservative leadership, when it comes to Washington next year, will have a home and a headquarters at the Conservative Partnership Institute.
Thank you for considering this request and for doing so much to help fight for the principles of freedom that make America great.

Sincerely,

Jim DeMintCPI Chairman

I wanted to send you a quick note before the day got away from me.
I’m about to head into debate prep because tonight I take the stage with my opponent for the first time — and the only time he would agree to.
It’s a big moment for our campaign. Voters across North Carolina will be watching and deciding who they plan to vote for, and I am going to make my case to them directly because I know that we deserve better than another DC insider. We need a Senator who will put the people over corporate profits and the wealthy and well-connected.
But I am going to need your help to hold my opponent accountable. He is trying to hide behind super PAC ads and dodge reporters' questions about his extreme agenda — like a national abortion ban, his vote to overturn the 2020 election on January 6, and more.
So whatever happens tonight, I know we will need the resources to make sure North Carolinians know the truth about what’s at stake.
It’d mean a lot to have your support today to know that I’m not alone when I take the stage.
[**Will you consider making a $3 donation to my campaign to win North Carolina’s U.S. Senate seat? There’s a lot on the line, and we have to be ready.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221007-1-MA&t=2&akid=1963%2E357359%2ELNDM4p)
Thank you for standing shoulder to shoulder with me in this fight. I cannot tell you how much it means to me to know that we can count on you in these crucial moments.
Cheri

Without a doubt, the outcome of this election will determine the direction our country heads for the next two years. So while the parties are fighting to win contests around the nation, we have identified three key Senate races and six congressional seats where lifting the Black and Latino vote for Republicans can secure victories and give us more leverage in blocking the Democrats oppressive agenda during the 2nd half of Biden's presidency. * Pennsylvania - Open seat due to Republican Pat Toomey's retirement. Fetterman (D) vs. Dr. Oz (R) - **WE NEED TO HOLD IT**

* OH-09 - Kaptur (D-Incumbent) vs. J.R. Majewski (R-Challenger) - **WE NEED TO GAIN IT**
* TX-15 - Open Seat due to Gonzalez (D) running in TX-34. De La Cruz (R) vs. Vallejo (D) - **WE NEED TO GAIN IT**
* TX-28 - Cueller (D-Incumbent) vs. Garcia(R-Challenger) - **WE NEED TO GAIN IT**
* TX-34 - Flores (R-Incumbent) vs. Gonzalez (D-Challenger) - **WE NEED TO HOLD IT**

Those are the seats that we think can make the difference in November as to whether the Liberals have free reign to advance their socialist agenda or whether we have enough Republicans to roadblock and thwart their progress. We MUST make sure that minorities hear the truth before November 8, 2022. And minority voters are waking up. subject: This is a long, but very personal message
disclaimer_text:

by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vs5rSBZhN9

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/os5rSBZhN9

Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit
about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in
Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my
family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also
studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping
others in need.

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to
serve our country in the United States Army while I started my
nursing career.

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever,
Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing
him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his
eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to
be by Scotty's side.

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was
informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in
uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on
the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the
Army.

I refused.

Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty
Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the
way.

It's not every day you hear about American women going up
against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big
way-and won.

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right
thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue
being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never
be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an
incredible father and hero to our boys.

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for
US Senate to help families across the country achieve the
American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty
Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown
throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better
life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a
voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the
partisan gridlock in Congress.

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we
look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the
United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning
this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. So
please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the
momentum we've achieved so far.

KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT

STAND UP FOR AMERICA

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

Hey, it's
Tiffany Smiley.

The
Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the
COUNTRY!

Needless
to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the
November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our
state.

We are in
an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you.
Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader
with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American
Dream is not lost.

Rush
support now to be a part of history.

Let's
raise money and WIN,

Tiffany
Smiley

JOIN TEAM SMILEY

Team
Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know
we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key
deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether
or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the
Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany
is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year
incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things
around TODAY.

There's
no time to wait on the sidelines.

That's
why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!

This is
our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for
Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S.
Senate, plain and simple.

Our team
doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today,
so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help
increase our momentum!

Tiffany
is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh
leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be
your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out
of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this
moment. Step up now!

Scan to
reveal a message from Tiffany Smiley.

military rank, job titles, and photographs in uniform does not

Four years ago, my daughter Jaime was murdered with an assault weapon in the Parkland massacre. Ever since, Republicans like Jenn Giroux have not only done almost nothing to solve a problem, but, in fact, they've passed legislation in Ohio and other states to allow any criminal or terrorist to carry concealed weapons of war in our streets, by eliminating background checks. We've seen the results in Uvalde, Buffalo, Highland Park, and in 2019, the Oregon, District of Dayton, Ohio, when nine people out for a fun night on the town were murdered, and 17 others sent to local hospitals with their lives never to be the same. After the awful Supreme Court decision overturning Roe v Wade, Giroux also came out against abortion in all cases--making the ridiculous claim that women never have to choose between their lives and having an abortion. This is crucial, as Nan Whaley has a good chance of being Ohio's next Governor. even if the worst happens and Mike DeWine is reelected, on the few of things where DeWine isn't as crazy as the gerrymandered state house, they won't be able to override his veto. It is also key to getting closer to taking back the state house under the newer lines prescribed by a constitutional amendment to the state constitution. So I'm asking for your help, friend. If we can help Rachel Baker overcome the right-wing money and win this race, we'll also helping turn out voters to help elect Whaley, and Democrats Greg Landsman in a swing House seat and Tim Ryan as our U.S. Senator. I've often said I consider Ohio a second home, as much of my family lives in the Cincinnati area. But, also, America is my home, and this race will have ripple effects across the country. | | | | | | | | Thank you for helping me make sure no family ever has to feel the loss that I've felt every day since losing Jaime. | _Natalie James is a Democrat running for the U.S. Senate in Arkansas.__Natalie has dedicated her life to standing up for people,__ands she 's running to bring that record of service and accountability to Washington. _ _We 're counting on grassroots support to flip this seat and protect our Senate majority._
---
|

| | |

| Friend-- I want to start this email off by saying thank you. Because of you, we're heading into Election Day with strength and momentum behind our campaign to enact meaningful, positive change for our communities and working families. I'm proud to say that this campaign has been a grassroots-led effort from the beginning, and it means the world to me to have your confidence. I also want to take a moment to remind you why I got in this race. **So, here 's my story:** My parents raised me with Arkansas values -- hard work, gratitude for our incredible public lands, and the importance of caring for one another. I have spent my entire career fighting on the frontlines for underserved and rural communities. **Right now, Arkansas is at a crossroads.** We are all feeling the effects of massive growth, whether it's rising housing prices, inflation, or our Main Streets and small businesses. Families are pulling up to gas stations and walking into grocery stores to find that everything is more expensive. I'm running for United States Senate because I know we can do better for Arkansas families. We deserve a representative in Washington who knows what it's like to struggle to make ends meet. Who'll fight to make sure we have good jobs and wages and will work across the aisle to make sure that families who have been here for years or generations can afford to stay. Winning this race isn't going to be easy. John Boozman's special interest and corporate PAC donors think they can buy this Senate seat, but they're no match for our strong, grassroots movement. [** _These last few weeks before the election are critical for getting our message out to as many Arkansans as possible. Could you chip in $10 to support our fight to the finish?_**](https://he35og.fd52.fdske.com/ec/gAAAAABjQDErGLo-niXraL7mzC2hmjq2Cb_TGRQWTYQCdqHnGCIp7B7jnvYxIzka_K5lrFwWztJz2ZMOnL16417ZocUtEjzjifMFddNMcmbl9F9uCpKxAEgdB6Fquy6YeJH_rhvy4aqbOkyYBUao1i5jgvCMedCgrBszlbKLTYprvE-5Caugaof-HL8so39DSLYojMgMUW3STPa94cTCpt9L2D2wcbUI3olfuDLxxGb3ZmB7QtvMW87ZN88VfDFTajAxFhwQ6XbEE2lkpw5zWP-lh4cdniwmltB1FlgASABBsSmrGF2kWIrbiUO7WO1FRA9ClQ0iYEiugrL5XqGkBm2N7f4T8n1IjD2mE9MX58aAOMtA-YMYYsHc_3RAyTMjShryiqEkpe2WhGibAWbHeOlGNNR_ZOW2uXWGrcrAHYB7dA_LXGhd8TY=)

#

Friends —
I gave it all I had on the debate stage last night. Now, voting begins in Arizona on October 12. That means our window to reach the voters we need is closing.
I’m gonna keep working hard all the way to Election Day, but I’ll be honest: A lot of this depends on you.
This was always going to be one of the most expensive races in the country. But the amount of outside money coming into Arizona to boost Blake Masters and hurt my campaign is shocking — even for me. It feels like another Super PAC or dark money group is announcing another million dollar TV ad every couple days.
And after Masters had his biggest platform yet at our debate last night, we’ve got to be able to set the record straight.
Especially after the NRSC reversed course and has decided to spend an additional SEVEN figures in Arizona between now and the election. It’s a sign that they are all-in on Masters and will do anything to close the gap in these final weeks.
I know I’ve asked a lot, team. But I really need your help, and the ball’s in your court now. If you’ve been waiting to make that first contribution, now is the time. This seat is at risk, and if we don’t hold onto it we’re likely to lose the Senate.

body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

In a moment, I’m going to tell you the story of why I am in this race to
become the next Governor of Georgia, [ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=Sa_em_221007_B1_SYAStory_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=11148%2E1862389%2EphIjhx ]but first, could you donate to our
campaign before early voting starts in just 10 days?

Growing up in Mississippi, my family only had one car, so my dad would
sometimes have to hitch rides or walk for long stretches of his 30-mile
trip home from the shipyards where he worked.

One rainy night, my father failed to return home hours after his shift.
Mom got worried. So we piled in the car and went out looking for him. When
we found Dad, he was walking along the road, soaking wet and shivering in
his shirtsleeves. He explained that he had given his coat to a homeless
man he’d met on the highway.

When we asked him why he gave away his only coat, he said: “I knew when I
left that man, he’d still be alone. But I could give him my coat, because
I knew you were coming for me.”

The lesson I learned that night still resonates with me to this day: none
of us succeed alone — when times are tough, we persevere because our
family, friends and neighbors will come for us.

I’m running for governor because I am ready to lead Georgia to its next
and greatest chapter — where Georgians have healthcare, housing, education
and a good living, where Georgians will know that someone is coming for
them, too.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=Sa_em_221007_B1_SYAStory_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=11148%2E1862389%2EphIjhx ]But I can’t do it alone. With early voting starting in just a matter of
days, I’m counting on this grassroots team to power us to victory. This
team has never let me down before — can you chip in $5 to
help me build a state where everyone can thrive?

Thank you for your support,

Stacey

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents – AND WIN!**

And now I’m pursuing two class action lawsuits and other important legal actions to get justice for the January 6 Protesters and take on Joe Biden’s rotten regime in court.

[Fellow Patriot, PLEASE help me double down in my fight to GET JUSTICE FOR ALL JANUARY 6 PROTESTERS AND SET THEM FREE with your absolutely vital gift of $10, $25, $50, $100 or even more RIGHT NOW.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z9ltkl0uicne8t9j5nd8kt2qurdjle6tlnljkuio_rp22sh2s8i66or5chhm9oj4c3h2bs)

I’m using two powerful class action lawsuits and other hard-hitting legal actions to accomplish this.

The clock is ticking for our country.

Sincerely,

Larry Klayman
Founder of both Judicial Watch and Freedom Watch
Current Chairman and General Counsel of Freedom Watch, Inc.

[Please think of Jesus Rivera and each of the January 6 Peaceful Protesters I’m fighting for...then dig deep and give a vital $10, $25, $50, $100 or more right away.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zbjhd1j1qstu3cno4f1dpusb3i200grnk52tfn98_rp22sh2s8i66or5chhm9oj4c3h2bs)

**Free the January 6 Protestors!
**
Right now, un-American politicians and corrupt members of the Department of Justice are keeping hundreds of our fellow Americans in jail without due process...they’re often abused and beaten...they’re blocked from seeing their wives and children...and kept from seeing their lawyers!
