clean_body: Peter, Yesterday we found out that Phil Knight made a $1 million donation to Republican Christine Drazan, switching candidates from unaffiliated Betsy Johnson. This is a huge development in the governor’s race, and it means that Drazan will have the funds she needs to stay competitive with Tina in this extremely close race. Drazan has already said that if she is elected she will reverse Governor Brown’s executive order on climate and try to eliminate our Clean Fuels Program. We can’t let that happen. With gratitude, April Christenson OLCV Development Director \---------------------------------- Peter, We just found out yesterday that Nike co-founder Phil Knight donated $2 million to Betsy Johnson in September, bringing his total donations to her campaign to a whopping $3.75 million. Johnson is polling below 20%, but she continues to raise massive amounts of money making her a potential spoiler in the governor’s race and helping Republican Christine Drazan, who has received large donations from the oil and gas industry. Recent polls show Drazan leading Tina Kotek, 32% to 31%. We can’t let an anti-climate extremist be our next governor. We’re going up against deep-pocketed opponents, but with the help of grassroots supporters like you, we can get Tina elected. Thanks for all you do. Sincerely, April Christenson OLCV Development Director | | | Peter, The election is less than six weeks away and I can’t overstate its importance for the future of our state. Both of the candidates running against OLCV-endorsed former House Speaker Tina Kotek have been named to LCV’s 2022 Dirty Dozen in the States, the worst candidates in the country for our environment. This is the first time ever that two candidates in the same race have both been on the list, which highlights how dangerous both Betsy Johnson and Christine Drazan are for Oregon’s environment. Right now, polls show Tina in a virtual tie with Christine Drazan, the Republican nominee for governor and former House Republican Leader. That means there’s a 50/50 chance of our next governor being an anti-environment extremist. We can’t let that happen. Christine Drazan is in lockstep with extremists and anti-environmentalists in her party. Independent candidate Betsy Johnson has a disastrous 20+ year anti-environment voting record. Both Drazan and Johnson have accepted significant money from the fossil fuel industry and have opposed every single major climate bill in Oregon’s recent history, including 100% Clean Energy for All, the Clean Energy Jobs bill, and the Oregon Environmental Protection Act. Drazan also helped lead the 2020 House Republican walkout to kill climate action. Both Betsy Johnson and Christine Drazan have pledged to end Governor Kate Brown’s executive order on climate if they are elected. We have no time to waste when it comes to addressing climate change and certainly no time to go backwards. We can’t risk electing either one of this dirty duo. This race is critical for the future of our state and our planet. We need all the support we can get to ensure that our next governor is a climate and environmental champion. # **Newsletter-October 7 Vol. 2, #33**
---
| | |
##
7 October 22

Mail-In Ballots are now in the hands of voters and voting has begun. In 2 weeks, early voting begins (Oct 27-Nov 3). We have a lot of work to do! We need your help to get America back on course.

For the first time in 35 years we have an opportunity to make a REAL difference in District 4. Please seize THIS moment!

**Please Consider Donating At Least One Hour Per Week
Sign Waving Or Leaving Jeff Warner's Pre-Recorded Message To Voters.

Sign Waving**
This Saturday, October 8
Noon-1p
The intersection of Cherry Hill Road & Route 1
Park at Starbucks or Shoppers parking lot
4750 Cherry Hill Rd, College Park, 20740
FREE JW4C T-shirt provided for those who have not yet received one.
If you have a JW4C T-shirt, please wear it.
Be sure to bring your water bottle.

**Leave Jeff Warner's Pre-Recorded Message To Voters**
Contact Val for the 15 minute training.
443-386-8303

**Final Donations**
We are excited and humbled to report that the campaign has over $53,000 in total donations! Thank You So Much! At $36,000, the campaign became the second highest District 4 Republican campaign in the last 35 years! For such a challenging District, we are in awe at the outpouring of support.
The election is coming up soon! Please consider making a generous contribution. The maximum contribution is $2900 per person. Your donation will help us secure our commitments for print ads, radio ads and texting which all need to be purchased in advance. Your donation will help us secure our media commitments.
Consider, $100, buys:
* 1 Radio Ad
* 5 Large Signs
* 20,000 texts

How many can you help us purchase?
**Social Media**
Don't miss some of the amazing stories on social media @RepJeffWarner.

**Yard Signs**
We want to begin having yard signs pop-up throughout the District especially for those who live on or near busy roadways.
Yard Signs are FREE, yet we are requesting a minimum $10 donation, if you're in a position to donate.

We are asking you for your donations, for your service, and your prayers. Together, we can do this! This is the power of teamwork! And the Best Is Yet To Come! Please reach out to us at info@JeffWarnerForCongress.com

In 4 weeks, the General Election counting will be in process. Let's Get This Done! Together!

[**Donate Here**](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2b757c427e67a891eab3e1b8&id=aa610a4c0c&e=12a37459a2)

Remember, Jeff Warner is standing with you and for you. Enough is Enough! Together, "We The People" can make a real difference. Now is our time to act. THERE IS HOPE!

Standing with you,

Jeff

# **New Sykes Ad, “Caught,” Highlights Gesiotto Gilbert’s Dangerous Agenda for Ohio**

**Gilbert Supports A Total Abortion Ban With No Exceptions for Rape or Incest, Would Cut Social Security & Medicare, Raise Taxes on Middle Class Ohioans**
---
| **AKRON, OH —** In a new television ad, Emilia Sykes for Congress highlights why multi-millionaire Republican nominee Madison Gesiotto Gilbert and her dark money allies are lying about her record. The truth is, Madison’s [false attacks](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=274685f69d&e=7730fa895a) are blatant attempts to distract from Gesiotto Gilbert’s extremist anti-choice stance and efforts to lower taxes for millionaires like herself.

**“Madison Gesiotto Gilbert and her dark money supporters are lying about Emilia Sykes because they’re desperate to hide Gilbert’s dangerous agenda for Northeast Ohio,” **campaign spokesperson Sam Herd said.** “She'd be a rubber stamp for the most extreme right wing policies - gutting Social Security and Medicare, ripping away women's freedoms and giving tax breaks to herself at the expense of working people.”** **[Click HERE to view “Caught.”](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=bcfa7c42f6&e=7730fa895a)**
---
| [ ](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=fa07d0af37&e=7730fa895a)
---
| Below is the transcript for “Caught.”
I’m Emilia Sykes, and I approve this message.
Madison Gesiotto Gilbert caught lying about Emilia Sykes,
Hiding her extreme agenda,
Because Gilbert supports a total abortion ban with no exceptions for rape and incest,
Not even if the victim is a 10-year-old girl.
And Gilbert will push for tax cuts for millionaires like herself,
While raising middle-class taxes and cutting Social Security and Medicare.
Madison Gesiotto Gilbert — too dangerous for Ohio.

The OH-13 congressional race is a highly competitive matchup between Sykes and anti-choice extremist Madison Gesiotto Gilbert, who [district-shopped as she weighed in on where to run for office](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=6acef01ba3&e=7730fa895a). Inside Elections has [rated this race as “toss-up.”](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=e8fdcea1a3&e=7730fa895a) ** ** ###
---
| **About Emilia Sykes**
Emilia Sykes is the State Representative for Ohio’s 34th legislative district. Born in Akron and raised on the city’s west side, Emilia has worked tirelessly to keep jobs in our state and expand opportunity for working families in Northeast Ohio. As House Minority Leader she worked with Republicans and Democrats to deliver real results for Ohio’s families, businesses, and seniors.

Emilia will bring a fresh perspective to Washington, and fight for opportunity for every child, senior, and family in Northeast Ohio, regardless of their politics or beliefs.

Learn more about Emilia Sykes at [www.EmiliaSykesforCongress.com](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=d6b9f93bff&e=7730fa895a). Follow along for updates @[EmiliaSykesOH](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=9a9cd0d35a&e=7730fa895a) on Twitter and on Facebook at [Facebook.com/E](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=e08f9d24c3&e=7730fa895a)[miliaSykes](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=40e1ccecd8&e=7730fa895a).

clean_body: Peter, check out what my team and I are up to... | | | Hi Peter – I hope you're having a great start to October! We're just over a month away from the midterm elections, and my team and I at United Rural Democrats have been gearing up for our final push. Last month, we reached out to thousands of voters, supported dozens of candidates, and expanded our reach across rural America. Thank you, Peter, and now drumroll please – here is our September recap. I spoke at my first keynote address this month at an event for the Huron County Democratic Party in Ohio. We talked about why rural communities are the backbone of this country, and where Democrats can step up to gain seats in 2022. We had an outpouring of support for decorating our new headquarters in the best way possible – with yard signs from rural candidates running across the country. I haven't hung the yard sign that I received from the Delaware Democratic Party, but it might be my favorite...so far. Feel free to send more signs in! Last but not least, we met with Christina Bohannan, who is running for Congress in Iowa's 1st Congressional District, at a parade in East Moline, Iowa. We're excited to be supporting Christina, a mom, law professor, state representative, and former engineer! Thanks for supporting rural Democrats, Peter, and for an amazing September. clean_body: | | | | | Hello Waltz Warriors, Despite the horrible destruction Hurricane Ian has caused, Floridians and their unbreakable spirit will get through this tragedy. We are dedicating this newsletter to sharing resources, highlighting the latest recovery news, and sharing updates from Mike in the district. Our hearts and prayers are with every single person who lost their homes and livelihoods, and especially those who have lost loved ones. Nothing is stronger than Florida’s fight to overcome. Together, we will get through this tough time. | Resources Need help recovering from the destruction left behind by Hurricane Ian? Here’s a list of organizations ready to help. Please reach out if you need help: ➡️ ➡️ ➡️ Veterans, service members & loved ones, here’s a list of organizations ready to help and support you as we recover from Hurricane Ian: ➡️ ➡️ ➡️ ➡️ | In the District Over the last week, Mike has been in the district surveying the damage Hurricane Ian caused and meeting with first responders at Emergency Operations Centers in Volusia, Flagler and St. Johns counties in an effort to get a handle on how the federal government can continue assisting storm victims. Mike also met with Red Cross volunteers from all over the country at the Daytona Beach Ocean Center shelter on Wednesday. Thank you to all the brave first responders, service members, and volunteers who are all working hard to keep our community informed and safe as we begin to rescue & recover from the damage left behind by Hurricane Ian. Mike visited the St. Johns River to report it is STILL rising and flooding areas in central FL as the massive rainfall from the hurricane drains into our rivers and lakes. Pleased to see FEMA open individual assistance for Lake County! Visit . | In the News WALTZ ON BIDENS VACCINE MANDATE On Monday, Mike joined to discuss the Biden administration's 'asinine' mandate that will cost some U.S. service members their jobs: "With natural disasters, Russia threatening nuclear war and China's rapid military buildup, we can’t lose over 22k service members over a vaccine that doesn’t stop the spread. Kicking out troops over a vaccine is illogical & extremely harmful to our readiness and recruitment." Watch the entire interview for yourself WALTZ ON HURRICANE IAN Later that day, Mike joined again to discuss Hurricane Ian's damage and the Biden Administration's vaccine mandate further: "[My district] really took a 1-2-3 punch between the river flooding, the unprecedented amounts of rain, and storm surge on the east coast as well. We have sewage facilities that were overwhelmed, roads that have been backed up, dunes that have been breached, but the biggest piece is the historic level of flooding." Watch the Fox hit . WALTZ ON BIDENS TRIP TO FLORIDA On Tuesday, Mike Waltz discussed expectations for Biden's trip to Florida to survey the damage caused by Hurricane Ian on , saying: "This is going to be a long-term effort. What I hope the president will do is show leadership and encourage Pelosi and Schumer to not load up some future disaster relief bill with progressive priorities. What I'd really like Congress to do is look at some of our COVID and and repurpose that in the short-term rather than spending new money." Watch the interview . WALTZ ON HURRICANE IAN, ILLEGAL MIGRANTS, & HUNTER BIDEN Then on Wednesday, Mike joined to talk about the aftermath of Hurricane Ian in Florida, illegal migrants, and Hunter Biden's business dealings. "When I reach out to veterans who aren't getting the services they need, teachers whose schools are already crowded, hospitals that can't provide all the services they want to-- There is an opportunity cost to American citizens when we have 2 million people a year that are flowing across our border." Watch the entire segment | | Essential Mission Brief Reading | Social Media Here are a few of our top posts from social media this week. Be sure to like and share, and when you tweet at Mike remember to use #WaltzWarriors | | | | | | That's it for this week. Thanks for all of you support and please stay safe out there. God bless Florida and God bless the United States of America. Be sure to follow Mike on social media! | | ---|--- | | Paid for by Michael Waltz For Congress | | Michael Waltz is a member of the Army National Guard. body:
This is a long email about what has happened in Wisconsin since Roe v. Wade was overturned. It’s important that you read it. | Hello — this is a long email, but it’s very important that you read it. This week, we marked 100 days since the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade, and millions of people across our country saw their access to abortion ripped away. Please give me a moment to explain what this new post-Roe reality looks like in Wisconsin. **Roe v. Wade prevented a cruel abortion ban that was passed in 1849 from going back into effect. With Roe gone, abortion is now a felony in our state.** This draconian ban provides NO exceptions for rape or incest. Patients can’t access the health care they need. Doctors could go to jail for doing their jobs. It’s horrific. When this law was put on the books in 1849, the Civil War was still over a decade away, women didn’t have the right to vote, and Wisconsin didn’t have electricity or running water. This archaic law is what governs our state now that Roe is overturned. Earlier this year, Governor Tony Evers called for a special session of the state legislature to repeal it. But the Republican majority took less than 60 seconds to gavel in and out — immediately shutting down any debate and refusing to take action to protect Wisconsinites’ reproductive rights. Just last month, the governor called for another special session to create a process for statewide referendums in Wisconsin, which would allow voters to directly challenge and repeal the criminal abortion ban. Again, Republican legislators gaveled in and out in under a minute and blocked any opportunity to allow the people to decide on laws that affect their health. The overwhelming majority of Wisconsinites support safe, legal access to reproductive health care. They deserve to have a say in our abortion laws. But when it comes to reproductive freedom in our state, the will of the people isn’t the law of the land. One of the most important things we can do to change that is by ensuring Governor Evers is re-elected and that his veto power is secure — this is our last line of defense for abortion rights in Wisconsin. Look, we know what will happen if Republicans continue to gain power. They have already laid out a dangerous agenda that will further restrict abortion access in the state. So I won’t mince words with you here: **A GOP-controlled legislature with a veto-proof supermajority in Wisconsin should scare the hell out of all of us.** Here’s why: Governor Evers has vetoed NINE anti-abortion bills while in office — dangerous and restrictive bills that will come back and become law if Republicans gain a supermajority and have the power to override his veto. We need to fight back for Wisconsin, for the country, and for our democracy because what happens here will affect everyone. I’m doing everything I can to help elect six pro-choice Democratic women running in the most competitive state legislative races in Wisconsin — because if we win these seats, we can block a GOP supermajority and save the governor’s veto. Unfortunately, with so many important elections happening across our state this November, their biggest challenge has been fundraising. That's why, today, I’m asking you to join me in supporting these candidates with a donation. **[Please make a contribution of any amount to help elect six pro-choice Democratic women to the state legislature in Wisconsin. body:
There is no better friend or advocate for the issue of gun safety than Senator Chris Murphy.
#

Friends -
There is no better friend or advocate for the gun safety movement than Senator Chris Murphy.
Today, he launched a campaign to raise $500,000 in 24 hours for 8 critical campaigns that will change the shape of the gun safety debate in the new Congress.
If that is all you need to hear, please split a donation between the eight campaigns here:
[**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nr8**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=nr8.aXEBBt&refcode=giffords-221007-60&t=1&akid=2573%2E3935704%2E76eYVt)
Otherwise, here’s a bit more information about each:
Our friend **Maggie Hassan** is in a close race in New Hampshire. She won her last race by just 1,017 votes, and she needs our help.
**Mandela Barnes** is running for Senate in Wisconsin and flipping this seat would do a lot to help Democrats hold the Senate and pass gun safety laws.
In Pennsylvania, **Josh Shapiro** is running for Governor. Pennsylvania is a key state, not just because of its large population, but its role in determining the 2024 presidential winner.
Three House incumbents, **Lauren Underwood (IL-14), Andy Kim (NJ-3) and Elaine Luria (VA-2)** are in close races. Lauren is part of the Gun Violence Prevention Task Force in the House, Andy has been a strong advocate in Congress, and Elaine represents Virginia Beach, which experienced a mass shooting with 12 deaths while she was in office.
**Gabe Vasquez (NM-2)** is facing an A-rated NRA-backed candidate who voted NO on the bipartisan gun safety legislation that passed earlier this year.
And finally, we’re backing a critical ballot initiative, **Oregon Ballot Measure 114** , that would mandate everyone complete a background check and pass firearm safety training before buying a gun.
All of these candidates and campaigns need our help. They cannot win alone. That is why we’re doing EVERYTHING we can to help them today.
So please:
[**Can you split a contribution—of any amount you can afford—between these 8 campaigns today? If we all come together and help win these races, we will be taking a big step forward for the gun safety movement in our country.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=nr8.aXEBBt&refcode=giffords-221007-60&t=2&akid=2573%2E3935704%2E76eYVt)

subject: Marijuana should be decriminalized, and I'm glad to see our country take a major step in that direction.

body:
President Biden is urging states to pardon folks convicted of simple possession. Georgia should heed his call.

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52146664/371413693/1460579386?refcode=EM_FR_221007MJ_N_JJ_FULL_6_NG_N_Logo&fn=&ln=&em=dpwillis67@gmail.com&add1=&ci=Cresco&st=PA&pc=18326&oc=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDAzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MzYwZTIyZi01YjQ2LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CHNLnBmuI5wgpa7YXra4jgETsXzXj8ZRyuKME1hGawA=)
---
Yesterday, President Biden announced that he is pardoning all federal convictions for simple marijuana possession. He also urged governors to do the same for state convictions. **This is a _major_ step in the right direction.**

The over-criminalization of marijuana has created vast inequities within the criminal justice system. There's no reason that people should lose the opportunity for future employment or housing due to a marijuana possession conviction — but this happens time and time again, and it disproportionately impacts Black and brown Americans.

Prosecuting marijuana possession has overburdened our prisons, and it's taken up law enforcement resources that could instead be used for going after violent crimes. **I believe in the decriminalization of marijuana, and I hope that Georgia can at least take the step of pardoning folks who have been convicted of simple possession.**

Georgians deserve an Attorney General who understands that equity and public safety go hand-in-hand. They need someone who's willing to advocate for necessary systemic changes.

Unlike Chris Carr, I'll prioritize tackling gun violence (I won't take money from gun manufacturers, for starters). I'll call out unjust laws that limit our police's ability to actually protect communities, and use my platform to advance justice wherever possible.

[**This is the reform that Georgians desperately need, and that's why we cannot come up short on November 8. clean_body: President Biden is urging states to pardon folks convicted of simple possession. Georgia should heed his call. = Yesterday, President Biden announced that he is pardoning all federal convictions for simple marijuana possession. He also urged governors to do the same for state convictions. This is a major step in the right direction. The over-criminalization of marijuana has created vast inequities within the criminal justice system. There's no reason that people should lose the opportunity for future employment or housing due to a marijuana possession conviction — but this happens time and time again, and it disproportionately impacts Black and brown Americans. Prosecuting marijuana possession has overburdened our prisons, and it's taken up law enforcement resources that could instead be used for going after violent crimes. I believe in the decriminalization of marijuana, and I hope that Georgia can at least take the step of pardoning folks who have been convicted of simple possession. Georgians deserve an Attorney General who understands that equity and public safety go hand-in-hand. They need someone who's willing to advocate for necessary systemic changes. Folks all across our region and our nation know what's at stake this November.
Peter,

Folks all across our region and our nation know what's at stake this November.

The power of the ballot during our Primary Election reaffirmed what I already knew: People want progress for our region - not political games or partisan extremism. **And with less than a month until Election Day, Team Kilmer has been hitting the campaign trail full speed ahead, and we don 't plan on slowing down until the last ballot is cast on November 8!**

[](https://act.myngp.com/el/Hf9ujpRLGj4WwsKbTadWQqes3StYPYLaTKhPvMqzquw=/iWOknHgzuJD_YnX1CZ2WYQSKnLST98XaVUmwJjfaNbA=?refcode=em22_221007_longfo_fnd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_221007_longfo_fnd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_medium=email&email={{EmailAddress%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&firstname={{FirstName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&lastname={{LastName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&zip={{ZipCode%2CDefaultTo%3D}})

Pro-Democracy, pro-choice, and for-the-people Democratic candidates are counting on folks like you to show up at the ballot box this November to make your voice heard. We can't afford to sit this election out, which is why I've been busy meeting folks all across our district and state, going door-to-door, and fighting to ensure that every eligible voter is ready to **VOTE VOTE VOTE!**
[](https://act.myngp.com/el/Hf9ujpRLGj4WwsKbTadWQqes3StYPYLaTKhPvMqzquw=/iWOknHgzuJD_YnX1CZ2WYQSKnLST98XaVUmwJjfaNbA=?refcode=em22_221007_longfo_fnd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_221007_longfo_fnd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_medium=email&email={{EmailAddress%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&firstname={{FirstName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&lastname={{LastName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&zip={{ZipCode%2CDefaultTo%3D}})
---
Peter, believe me when I say there's so much on the line in this election. Our fundamental rights and freedoms may come down to whether or not we can maintain our crucial (but narrow) Democratic majorities in the House and Senate, and that is something we can't afford to take lightly.

But I know that together, we will help people in our region be more secure economically. We will stand up for democracy reform and fight for accountability at all levels of government. And, we will get the government working again, for the people. My number one priority has always been to fight for the folks in our state and district. And until the final ballot is counted, our work must continue.
[](https://act.myngp.com/el/Hf9ujpRLGj4WwsKbTadWQqes3StYPYLaTKhPvMqzquw=/iWOknHgzuJD_YnX1CZ2WYQSKnLST98XaVUmwJjfaNbA=?refcode=em22_221007_longfo_fnd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_221007_longfo_fnd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_medium=email&email={{EmailAddress%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&firstname={{FirstName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&lastname={{LastName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&zip={{ZipCode%2CDefaultTo%3D}})
---
**Let me be clear: NONE of this would be possible without you by my side.**

**But running a winning campaign and traveling to every corner of our district to talk to folks about the issues they care about takes resources. That 's why I'm turning to grassroots supporters like you: [Will you chip in $10, or whatever you can, to support our people-powered campaign and help me keep fighting for a democracy that puts the people first?](https://act.myngp.com/el/Hf9ujpRLGj4WwsKbTadWQqes3StYPYLaTKhPvMqzquw=/iWOknHgzuJD_YnX1CZ2WYQSKnLST98XaVUmwJjfaNbA=?refcode=em22_221007_longfo_fnd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_221007_longfo_fnd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_medium=email&email={{EmailAddress%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&firstname={{FirstName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&lastname={{LastName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&zip={{ZipCode%2CDefaultTo%3D}})**

Peter, [**This week, a national left-wing immigration organization ranked Katie as the senatorial candidate in the country with the second-most “extreme” border security views**.** **](http://links.katiebrittforsenate.com/u/click?_t=64058844820c43dab0e6ed55204bc487&_m=af3606fed7f04d9b9cd3a771b8a9c394&_e=Rw-eRvIvnkKK0kF98ND9iWjthrXSV_V26dbaYWncFoyUX1RRLbY-gK2R49iJn6XEDyqfX7JdVQ_MdO2lvTWec871DEGEqQ8y32JunRbA174PCJeu8qHnHj0CzPtxme4YPMTLIxoluqXmyVjtP11D0fmtSdpfesEkbEVVzy14wRJ4Yzg5Szf2mXl0dOAi1KZ_sl_sGNXzpvUnOoDOUoGOihpp_apMBdeHUqf_YXE9kc6sZA6mYU4UCPbm9sbAElxxreUF5CEcS_9nQ9nA5gdSikNyw4ruWpDbiTsznL8azsIcGxsC5UoERyf4v0qtpUF09ONSdDR3nsTV7tFvxgMMVCFRZz7fnniyqk2muDlV0wU2KiLCU2jUK4KVxUyxujElDW0Sgm-dMgzs1dWNvVDM-P3lGkROAYNdl2LtHyYml8I%3D) But what exactly about her plan is the radical left calling “extreme”? Take a look:
---
* Combat the flood of fentanyl pouring into American communities.
* Fully reinstate the Remain in Mexico policy.
* End catch and release.
* Finish building the border wall.
* Reduce overall legal immigration to a “sensible level” and transition to a new system that prioritizes skills and merit.
* Overhaul guest worker programs that “depress wages and rob American workers of job opportunities.”
* Permanently address the “deeply flawed and corrupt” EB-5 investor visa program.

**Chabot Campaign’s Third TV Ad: Morrow Mom Says “We Simply Can’t Afford Greg Landsman.”** _Highlights the Choice Between Chabot’s Record of Results and Greg Landsman’s Tax-Hiking, Inflation-Fueling Agenda

_**For Immediate Release
** Contact: John Gomez Email: [jgomez@chabotforcongress.com](mailto:jgomez@chabotforcongress.com) CINCINNATI – Congressman Steve Chabot’s campaign released its third television ad of the 2022 cycle on Friday. The ad, called “[Rising Costs](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=79a3d93dab20480bba6d9b819d7fa92d&_e=fEEBZMlXwIByD-L0xrEou34_i8paCmEL-ffC7EDwxx9V4TEuBx7etp9g8k663tu0yiOF7dIWwdfYDYiA5ribArG6XX1-s9Hjprj9ZP-r5xlwtbTfwfhBZ0j6zEaCTeNOt5nDFIx7ahASmn71OpNlxtM8RXJhuycYECqLERGLdbGHa38xSYFWlfjLY0xuKUpEirwlieysFDthVzsyt2UK-A%3D%3D)” features an Ohio mom who highlights the stark contrast in the race for Ohio’s First Congressional District. “Voters have a clear choice between Congressman Chabot and his proven record of delivering results and fighting for lower costs or former Pelosi staffer Greg Landsman and his tax-hiking, inflation-fueling agenda that increases the burden on hardworking families and undermines our economy,” said Chabot campaign manager John Gomez. “Southwest Ohio families who deserve relief from out-of-control inflation and rising costs simply cannot afford Greg Landsman in Congress.” Watch the ad, “Rising Costs,” [HERE](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=79a3d93dab20480bba6d9b819d7fa92d&_e=fEEBZMlXwIByD-L0xrEou34_i8paCmEL-ffC7EDwxx9V4TEuBx7etp9g8k663tu0-BAhAPvluRHMzNmnu7drQ3K4Kg9lrmI5Ly6MYMF2MgIjsmg4MPgQnrjSCVwvBvl_WFQuJZIDOHIcdVTO5gCVjPtpfo6f4wc9ulRa2nmCrtitO3_SQDCgGzFEsa6OeUVp0XucYgQIqTf8osAmf7Jpqw%3D%3D). Friend,
**Yesterday, President Biden took unprecedented steps to rectify decades of unjust cannabis policies in the United States. **
President Biden announced the following:
1. **A full pardon for prior federal offenses for simple possession of cannabis.** This will help U.S. citizens and lawful permanent residents who currently face barriers to housing, employment, education, and other services due to past possession.
2. **A call-to-action for all governors to issue pardons for state cannabis possession offenses.** Governors can ensure that no one is in state or local jail for simple possession of cannabis.
3. **The attorney general and Health and Human Services Department will begin a full review of how cannabis is currently treated as a Schedule I drug under federal law.** Changing how cannabis is scheduled could help advance the use of medicinal cannabis and scientific research.

**This is yet another move by President Biden that proves he is listening to the voices of younger generations — and it gives thousands of Americans a chance at a better life. **
[Tell your governor to follow the lead of President Biden and issue pardons for state cannabis possession, so we can finally start fixing our nation’s broken drug policies.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52179091/371475161/-1228187799?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZGVhMGM0ZC04MjQ2LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Lv5UQw5rTJJlFCOa-Bu2f2HMToFE2iTloYXGdNn7Npc=&emci=f9d63c63-7f46-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=8dea0c4d-8246-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=6787172)

These senseless laws do nothing to keep us safe and prevent people from accessing housing, jobs, and an education after their sentence.
Since most arrests related to cannabis are at the state or local level, federal action is important but it’s not enough.**It’s up to governors in all 50 states to follow President Biden’s lead and issue pardons for prior cannabis possession offenses. **

Black and brown Americans are disproportionately arrested and convicted for cannabis possession — even while it’s legal in many states. These senseless laws do nothing to keep us safe and prevent people from accessing housing, jobs, and an education after their sentence. Since most arrests related to cannabis are at the state or local level, federal action is important but it’s not enough.It’s up to governors in all 50 states to follow President Biden’s lead and issue pardons for prior cannabis possession offenses. "CTA Button" Yesterday’s news proves that young people have the power to build a better, more just future for us all. When we speak out in historic numbers, leaders like President Biden listen. Fellow patriot,

Democrats love to virtue signal non-stop, and cancel anyone who disagrees with them. For the longest time, it worked.

**But now, conservatives know the Left’s game, and how to beat it.** The key is to be PROUD of our beliefs, ignore the liberal attacks, and tell everyday working-class Americans what we believe -- and how our principles make their lives better.

Now, we’re seeing Republicans of all stripes filing to run for office, saying what’s on their mind, and defending our shared beliefs.

Let me be clear: The Republican Party welcomes anyone who shares our values. My friend Monica De La Cruz knows that, too. In 2020, **Monica De La Cruz fell short just 6,588 votes from winning a seat in Congress that has been held by Democrats for over 100 years**. Now, I'm asking for you to help my friend make it to the top of the hill this time around | Fellow patriot, Democrats love to virtue signal non-stop, and cancel anyone who disagrees with them. For the longest time, it worked. But now, conservatives know the Left’s game, and how to beat it. The key is to be PROUD of our beliefs, ignore the liberal attacks, and tell everyday working-class Americans what we believe -- and how our principles make their lives better. Now, we’re seeing Republicans of all stripes filing to run for office, saying what’s on their mind, and defending our shared beliefs. Let me be clear: The Republican Party welcomes anyone who shares our values. My friend Monica De La Cruz knows that, too. In 2020, Monica De La Cruz fell short just 6,588 votes from winning a seat in Congress that has been held by Democrats for over 100 years. Had she been successful, Monica would have been the first Hispanic Republican ever elected to Congress from South Texas. Will you please to help me end 120 years of Democrats holding the congressional seat she's currently running for? I encouraged Monica to try again – a 6,000 vote deficit is easily overcome with the right message and enough support. . Monica has set a personal goal of raising $15,000 before October 9th, and I’ve pledged to do all that I can to help her realize her goal. We need more people like Monica in Congress; she is living proof of the American Dream. She knows that in America, when you set your mind to something you can achieve it. She was raised by a single mother in a Texas border town, despite the hardships, Monica struck out on her own to realize her own American Dream. Armed with her faith and support from her Mother, Monica grew up to become one of the top insurance agents in South Texas. We need people like Monica in Congress. A woman who knows what hard work is; a woman who has the perseverance and grit to deliver for her community. ---
| | **October 7, 2022**
---
| | **Come See Delegate Greenhalgh at Fil Fest Tomorrow**
---
| |
---
| | The 8th annual Fil Fest begins tomorrow at Mount Trashmore! The festival will include local food, vendors, and entertainment on both Saturday and Sunday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Delegate Greenhalgh will attend tomorrow's festivities from 11:00 AM to 1:00 PM to celebrate and meet with Fil Fest attendees. This is a free event open to the public celebrating the Filipino and military communities in Hampton Roads. We hope to see you there!
---
| | |
---
| | **Fall is Finally Here!**
---
| |
---
| |
---
|
---
|
---
| | After a long dry summer, our neighborhoods are ready for fall! Delegate Greenhalgh is enjoying the change of seasons, and all the fall decor that comes with it, while out walking doors in her district. Here are snaps of some of her favorites!
---
| | |
---
| | **Comment Period Now Open For New VDOE Policy**
---
| | Last month, the Virginia Department of Education (VDOE) rolled out a new model policy for schools regarding how to deal with transgender students. The new policy put parents front and center, ensuring that schools can no longer keep secrets. Parents must be informed if their student wants to be treated as a gender other than their biological sex. A 30-day comment period is now open, and the Board of Education needs to hear from you. [Please click here and share your support for the new policy today](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/23a9f17af7861f4f16f79d307c796b93/37923/5d79bc7c1e007c08/74c422eec78bc143c3d6b838967d376c/37923), and help ensure that the Board of Education knows that you support this policy because it puts parents back in charge of their children’s education. They’re our kids, not the state’s kids.
---
| | |
---
| | **Early Voting Has Begun!**
---
Early voting began on September 23rd. You can vote in person now up until November 5th at your designated polling location. Election Day is November 8th. To register to vote, check your registration status, or find your polling location, [click here](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/23a9f17af7861f4f16f79d307c796b93/37923/5d79bc7c1e007c08/191a719db5253b84c3d6b838967d376c/37923).

subject: The IRA, the SEC, and Scope 3: a love story
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY EVERGREEN ACTION
body:
They just go better together.
| [](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4354?t=2&akid=13105%2E53494%2EMtOMF1) Friend, Do you remember the Security and Exchange Commission's proposed climate rule? Big Polluters certainly do. They've launched an all-out fear-mongering attack on this rule—they're terrified that public companies will be required to publicly disclose their pollution and climate-related financial risks because it disrupts the fossil-fuel-centered business model that lines their pockets. But our case is only getting stronger. Thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act, the SEC's rule makes even more sense. [**_Want the full story? Read our latest blog now—and share it with your network to spread the word!_**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4354?t=3&akid=13105%2E53494%2EMtOMF1) | [READ ON](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4354?t=4&akid=13105%2E53494%2EMtOMF1)
---
Here's the gist: With the Inflation Reduction Act's $370 billion of climate investments, companies that invest in clean energy and decarbonization will enjoy enormous benefits—and those clinging to fossil fuels will lose market share.
Investors deserve reliable emissions disclosures from companies so they can assess which are truly prepared for the clean energy transition. And that means they need to have a full, accurate picture of a company's greenhouse gas pollution—including, for instance, emissions associated with burning the oil an oil company sells. These would be categorized as "Scope 3 emissions," which are often the vast majority of a company's pollution. These emissions must be reported if we hope to give investors full information.
**This is a huge opportunity, and I have so much more to say about this critical climate policy—but I'll stop there for now.[_Get the whole story at our blog!_](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4354?t=5&akid=13105%2E53494%2EMtOMF1)**

---
Together,
Lena Moffitt

Peter,

If you haven't heard, the Quad Cities have become ground zero in our effort to keep the House blue.

Here in IL-17, I'm running in a **pure tossup** race to keep our district from falling into Republican hands -- effectively handing them House control. And just north of the river in Iowa, my good friend Christina Bohannan is running a homegrown, grassroots effort to flip a long-time GOP stronghold.

| Peter,

It all comes down to me.

The Senate. America. Our children's future. Everything is riding on my race against John Fetterman.

I'm not afraid of this fight. I would never have jumped in this race if I wasn't ready for such a huge responsibility.

But I can't afford to be shy with so much on the line. So I'll just come right out and ask: **_[Can I count on you to dig deep and chip in whatever you can to help me win?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61546371:6BLQbFV8N:m:1:3317145305:0DEFB15907E1CC60C42FE9856B82BC4E:r "Can I count on you to dig deep and chip in whatever you can to help me win?")_**

John Fetterman simply cannot be allowed in Congress. His priorities will crush American families and put our communities at risk.

**He has pushed to free convicted murderers amid a massive spike in violent crime, and he 's committed to growing America's bloated and expensive bureaucracy.**

Fetterman's agenda will devastate our country, Peter. But he's still polling just ahead of me, thanks to his MASSIVE cash advantage.

We're now less than **35 days** from Election Day and this race is shaping up to be one of the most expensive in history. **My opponent raised over $5.5 MILLION in August from fundraising emails just like this.**

_**[That's why I'm coming to you and asking for a donation of any amount to supercharge my campaign and wash away Fetterman's cash advantage.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61546371:6BLQbFV8N:m:1:3317145305:0DEFB15907E1CC60C42FE9856B82BC4E:r "That’s why I’m coming to you and asking for a donation of any amount to supercharge my
campaign and wash away Fetterman’s cash advantage.")**_

I'm ready to face down my opponent's massive political machine by myself, Peter. But it would really help if I had you on my side.

Dr. Oz

My story is simple, Peter.

I was raised in abject rural poverty by a single mother. I dropped out of high school when I was 16 years old, joined the Navy at 18, and got my GED.

I then went on to serve this beautiful country for over 26 years as a Navy SEAL and completed 5 combat tours.

I got my undergraduate degree at 44 and was accepted to law school at 50.

My wife Sara Jane and I have been married for 29 years and have 4 children & 8 grandchildren.

_**This is why I love my country - I grew up in the meanest circumstances in the United States of America, yet here I am talking to you today as proof of the American Dream.**_

I don't want to go to Washington for myself, Peter. It's a corrupt and dysfunctional place.

I want to go there for you and be a __voice for the voiceless_._ I want to put an end to the left's radical policies and bring prosperity back to our nation.

So yes, my story is simple. But I am proud of it just as I am proud of every American who loves this country.

clean_body: this seat is within reach for Don Bolduc. | | | = Friends – = When I talk about the stakes of this race, I sometimes mention that the very fate of our democracy is on the line. Folks, I wish I was being hyperbolic. But here in New Hampshire – and across the country – Republicans who have undermined the strength of our democracy and pushed baseless election fraud conspiracy theories are running for office. And my opponent, Don Bolduc, is one of them. Just by peddling the Big Lie, Don Bolduc has taken part in attacking the foundations of our democracy. But now, as we face off in one of the top battleground races of 2022, the threat that he poses to our electoral process is not just theoretical, it’s real. If elected to the U.S. Senate, Don Bolduc, who has promised to “defy the presidential election results, should he be called upon to do so in 2024,” would be in a position to do just that. In 2016, I won this seat by the slimmest margin of any sitting Senator. Now, polls are tightening. What I’m trying to say is that with just 4 weeks until Election Day, this seat is within reach for Don Bolduc. I say all this not to scare you, but to help you understand what is at stake in this race. Peter,

When I decided to run for office, I knew I would be attacked. Unfortunately, that's politics these days.

I knew the Left would try to paint me as a man unfit to serve in public office. After all, I struggled with mental health issues when my professional football career ended. But I sought treatment, got help, and then spent the next decade encouraging others to get help if they needed it. In fact, I even wrote a book about my journey, _Breaking Free: My Life with Dissociated Identity Disorder_ , with the goal of helping others.

This summer, Raphael Warnock and Chuck Schumer's Super PAC spent more than $50 million attacking my character, my family, and my mental health struggles.

**But their ads didn't work.** The personal attacks against me failed to move the needle, so Raphael Warnock and I are neck-and-neck in the polls in the Georgia Senate race.

In their desperation to find something to distract the voters from real issues and blunt our momentum, they came up with an "October Surprise" alleging that I paid for a woman to have an abortion.

**Let me be clear: I have never paid for anyone to have an abortion. It's a flat-out lie.**

We cannot let the Left win by lying, cheating, or buying their way to victory. We need to stand together to fight back with the truth.

**[Peter, today I need your assistance more than ever before in this campaign. I need the resources to talk directly to the voters and clear the record.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61546389:JfCKlFV4N:m:1:3317145305:8407747825D555A203B930264E2DBB2E:r) **

Undecided voters are watching this race closely, and the Left knows it. That's why, 31 days before the election, they decided to distract from the real issues by telling a lie about me.

First, the Left used these tactics against Justice Clarence Thomas in an unsuccessful effort to keep him off the Supreme Court.

Then, 27 years later, they did the same thing to Justice Brett Kavanaugh as they tried to destroy him, his reputation, and his family.

Their intimidation tactics didn't work on Justices Thomas or Kavanaugh, and they're not going to work on me. Right now, all they've done is energize me more.

**The Left is desperate to win this Senate race because they want to change this country, but we're not going to let it happen.**

**[I need your help and support now more than ever. Will you please stand with me?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61546389:JfCKlFV4N:m:1:3317145305:8407747825D555A203B930264E2DBB2E:r)**

Thanks,

Herschel Walker

subject: Weekly Newsletter: Work Still to Be Done
body:
KeithPekau.com |
---
| | [ ](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=a11dc1ffd8&e=7dd0b93d07)
---
| |
---
| Peter,

I wanted to say a big ‘Thank you’ again for all your support of my campaign so far. I am truly honored to have earned your support.

Because of your hard work and generosity, we are getting our message out on TV and social media. I’m working hard each day to bring the common-sense leadership I employed in Orland Park to Washington, DC.

**But this race is far from over.** My Democrat opponent Sean Casten is endorsed and funded by Nancy Pelosi and special interest groups across the country. In fact, Pelosi just sent her Assistant House Speaker, Katherine Clark in to campaign with Sean.

**Casten has sponsored anti-police legislation, voted for massive spending bills and voted AGAINST a ban on Fentanyl. Like his leader, Nancy Pelosi, Sean Casten has used his position in Congress for financial gain.** If re-elected, Casten will follow Pelosi off the cliff and continue pushing the dangerous agenda that has led to crisis after crisis in America!

With millions of dollars coming from Pelosi, Washington elites and powerful DC lobbies, **Casten is extremely well funded**.

So much is at stake in the next 30 days and it’s only going to get worse if the Democrats increase their power in Washington. [That’s why I am asking you to go all in on this one.](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=2023dc1655&e=7dd0b93d07)

Please consider investing in this race one more time to help ENSURE we have the resources needed to get our message to voters over the lies from Casten, Pelosi and the Democrat Machine.

Thank you,

Keith Pekau
_Mayor of Orland Park
Republican Nominee for Illinois’ Sixth Congressional District_
---
|
---
| _**In Case You Missed It**_
**Fox News, Pekau Editorial: Illinois police reform act will eliminate cash bail and make our streets less safe**
With violent crime up across the nation, [Chicago has become the picture](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=bc447570eb&e=7dd0b93d07) of lawlessness: a haven for criminals and illegal activity. It is about to get worse. In January 2023, the Orwellian-named "SAFE-T Act" will go into effect. This legislation passed two years ago, and residents of Illinois are about to see the harsh realities of "police reform" packaged in a bill that eliminates cash bail almost entirely.

In the dark of night, the Illinois Legislature forced through one of the most anti-public safety bills in the country. The now infamous SAFE-T Act, which was authored and whipped by our attorney general and signed without amendment by our governor.

Recently, my comments about the bill went viral. The nation was rightly shocked to hear about the extreme measure that could have only passed in a state like Illinois where decades of one-party rule have bred contempt for transparency, constitutionality and moderation...

[Read the full op-ed here.](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=e5c1e6bb8d&e=7dd0b93d07)

**DuPage Policy Journal: Casten campaign ad violates FEC standards**
The Casten Campaign has been forced to pull down their ad “Ready to Choose” for non-compliance.

The ad, which misrepresents Casten’s opponent Keith Pekau’s views on abortion, was also missing the required campaign disclosure, which would read “approved by Sean Casten.”

“No one is shocked that lobbyist-turned-Congressman Sean Casten is producing unethical ads,” said Pekau. “The ad itself is full of misinformation. Disclaimers are one of the most basic aspects of producing a campaign ad, and his campaign left it off. But then again, we are talking about a guy who uses his seat of power to enrich himself and his family, and took an illegal property tax break on his luxury DC Condo. Ethical behavior is not his strong suit.”

[Read more here.](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=37f17f322b&e=7dd0b93d07)

**Mayoral Update**
During this week’s mayoral update, I talked about the impact that inflation is having on our community and region as a whole. Families across Illinois are struggling to make ends meet and it's important that elected officials at every level of government take that into account when making decisions.

[Watch here.](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=13980f9d85&e=7dd0b93d07)
---
| [ ](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=b2ffe6b122&e=7dd0b93d07)
---
|
---
| [Help bring common-sense leadership to Washington HERE!](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=954d6a26d4&e=7dd0b93d07 "Help bring common-sense leadership to Washington HERE!")
---
|
# **_Connecting the Dots_**
---
| **WICS / WRSP: Greene and Scott County State's Attorneys suing over SAFE-T-Act**
More Illinois State's Attorneys are filing lawsuits over the SAFE-T Act.

Greene County State’s Attorney Caleb Briscoe and Scott County State’s Attorney Richard Crews are the latest to file lawsuits, according to our media partner WLDS Radio.

The two are suing over the elimination of cash bail, which is part of the Pre-Trial Fairness Act.
Crews and Briscoe are asking for a permanent injunction of the SAFE-T Act.

[Full story here.](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=8e911109d6&e=7dd0b93d07)

**News-Gazette: Douglas County state's attorney, sheriff file suit on SAFE-T Act**
Douglas County’s state’s attorney and sheriff have filed a lawsuit in hopes of overturning the SAFE-T Act, the state’s criminal justice legislation that will eliminate cash bail on Jan. 1.

State’s Attorney Kate Watson and Sheriff Nathan Chaplin filed the suit at the Douglas County Courthouse on Tuesday, claiming the 764-page act contains “numerous constitutional violations.”

“This is not about politics; it is about public safety,” Watson said.

[Read the full story here.](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=7a285f1e10&e=7dd0b93d07)

**Madison-St. Clair Record: Haine, Lakin file bipartisan lawsuit to ‘protect county from dangers of SAFE-T Act’**
Madison County State’s Attorney Tom Haine and Sheriff John Lakin have joined a growing number of state officials suing Gov. JB Pritzker over the controversial SAFE-T Act set to take effect Jan. 1.

[Read the full story here.](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=93a24dd22c&e=7dd0b93d07)
---
| **_Get Involved_**
---
| Politicians in Washington, DC like Sean Casten, and Nancy Pelosi have put special interests, party politics, and extreme agendas ahead of doing what’s best for the people they’re supposed to represent.

Keith Pekau is the common sense, local leader we need in Washington to take on the extreme politicians. His record of results stands in stark contrast to the failed, divisive politics and rigid ideology of Sean Casten.

Whether you choose to contribute, knock on doors, or host a yard sign on your front lawn, every little bit counts and helps my campaign inch closer to victory.

[**Click here to get started!**](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=2e205afef5&e=7dd0b93d07)

Hey Derek, it's Gisele.
The finance team asked me to write you an email... so our favorite good boi Levi and I are here!

...and we just wanted to let you know that we’re less than 32 days away from the election!
Nothing makes me more uncomfortable than asking for money, Derek. But here I am because John + this entire grassroots team are worth it. Folks like you chipping in a little bit at a time have already made all the difference in this campaign, so I have to ask:
**[If you can swing it, will you make a donation of $5 to John’s campaign today? If you could chip in even a few dollars, we would deeply appreciate it.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221007-2?amount=5&refcode=em20221007-7613&refcode2=7613_434096_sEVzCi&akid=7613%2E434096%2EsEVzCi)**

The finance team asked me to write you an email... so our favorite good boi Levi and I are here! ...and we just wanted to let you know that we’re less than 32 days away from the election! **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

Fellow Conservative,

Yesterday I sent you an email letting you know that the race is tightening up as we barrel toward Election Day. It was my hope that the news about Politico moving my race from “likely Democrat” to “lean Democrat” would get all of you excited.

**The response was tepid, to say the least.** **Just 10 supporters donated to my campaign all day yesterday.**

With just 32 days until Election Day, that is how we lose this race - and the House majority. Fellow Conservative, **my opponent and her allies are spending more than $500,000 to attack me and slander my good name to the voters I’m asking to support me.**

With our race TIED this close to ballots going in the mail, **we cannot afford to lose your support now.**

Today, we need to double what we raised yesterday. That means **[before midnight tonight we must raise $2,418.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=07626d8f89214758858163e5e4c03729&_e=0nfrb88rVW8TPTkxLIg-UQBHUYFEGvuZXtSSV1s4suvUBMomvMmHADMBm8AD1_BqiROVjeb0AQc5ybSAybYhzhKKAEboZXcF3X3b-f9HEOMhRxCQl--M7Y0YeOpE6kjBhrJ8EVyQYUtSxuBSI-pT7iCgPTauSOAJ6qzNFojFbrZDAHPlBdAgBxYFtRhQ7WW2icQISfR5lITqENqYXQI9T_ACZRrN8Lrfs_zVJ6rSBor8TAx9pB94QOCCZ92ZCTFA6vehb69NulqVkna84M1CwbQluJ9oWOBbbKwmApACYn_5UvkU9_raDcccrxInhejNKC_3M57ag2rGstGt5p1SEZU7Yl1KBC7MXYMcl7fZSLTs_qCww2E8ExTi4MaB3XhXkZzJmWx42dZ23X2p874Iyw%3D%3D)**

**Are you able to chip in a couple of dollars to help me out right now?**

This week, the U.S. Chamber of Commerce announced its endorsement of Matt Jacobs in California’s 26th Congressional District! See their press release below.**
_" The Chamber endorses pro-business candidates for federal office who vigorously support public policy to advance economic growth, support jobs, and promote fiscal responsibility._ _“Born and raised in Ventura County, and with a career in public service as a federal prosecutor, Matt Jacobs understands the challenges facing southern Californians,”_ said Ashlee Rich Stephenson, Senior Political Strategist of the U.S. Chamber. _“Matt will be a fresh leader for the constituents of California’s Twenty-Sixth Congressional District. His commitment to pro-growth policies and free enterprise solutions have earned him the political support of the U.S. Chamber, and we are proud to endorse Matt Jacobs in his campaign for Congress."_
---
_“I'm deeply honored to receive the endorsement of the U.S. Chamber of Commerce, the nation's leading business organization,”_ Matt Jacobs said. _“Today, our local business community faces stark challenges – from rampant inflation to labor shortages, burdensome regulations to excessive taxation. In Congress, I look forward to working closely with the Chamber and all champions of free enterprise – not just those from my party – to support the entrepreneurs, innovators, job-creators, and businesses that power our local and national economy. If we do that, then the American economy will remain what it has long been: the greatest engine of prosperity in human history.”_ _"It is refreshing to have a candidate committed to fighting for small and family-owned businesses in this state,”_ said Roger Alves, CEO of Scosche Industries._“We have been over-regulated, over-taxed, and litigation targets far too long! The landscape of legislation in Washington needs to change to enable manufacturing to come back to America. We believe Matt is the guy who can do just that."_
---

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: We’re heading out on the road
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
There has never been a more crucial moment in time for our country and our democracy.
#
Peter, we’re heading on the road!
**Today, we’re launching our Defend the Majority tour ahead of the midterm elections, a nationwide effort to preserve our majority in the House.**
As part of the tour, I’ll be visiting states all over the country to help turn out the vote, elect Democratic candidates, and defend the Democratic majority. I am looking forward to talking to people about all that we’ve accomplished these last two years and why they need to make their voices heard at the ballot box.
This is just the beginning of our tour, and we’re going to be covering **a lot** of ground throughout October. [**In order to maintain our momentum and make sure we can connect with as many voters as possible across the country, we’ll need a lot of resources. That’s why I’m coming to you today to ask: will you donate to support the tour today?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16153?c0=20221007.uNoQss&refcode=em20221007-1688&t=1&akid=1688%2E420207%2EKuXbH-)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16153?c0=20221007.uNoQss&refcode=em20221007-1688&t=20&akid=1688%2E420207%2EKuXbH-)**
**There has never been a more crucial moment in time for our country and our democracy.** While Republicans continue to prop up the Big Lie and set their sights on gutting Social Security, Medicare, and access to safe and legal abortion, Democrats continue to champion an actual vision for governing, one rooted in lifting up our working families.
The midterm elections will be one of the most consequential elections for our country. I’m honored to be helping so many of our great candidates in their fight to protect our right to choose, guarantee universal healthcare, and safeguard free and fair elections.
[**Will you chip in $3 or anything you can to help support our tour as we travel across the country to protect our majority?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/16153?c0=20221007.uNoQss&refcode=em20221007-1688&t=21&akid=1688%2E420207%2EKuXbH-)
Thank you for your support,
Pramila Jayapal

the strongest gun laws in the country.

restricted ghost guns and the kits used to build them, and we’ve even
passed a bill that holds gun manufacturers responsible for their role in
the gun violence epidemic.

anywhere in the country. Almost 2x less than states with Republican
governors like Florida and Texas, and almost 2-and-a-half times less than

**\- INDems: Mike Pence Should Cancel His Fundraiser for Diego Morales -** This week, INDEMS called on former Vice President Mike Pence to cancel his scheduled fundraiser with Diego Morales on October 12. This comes after a bombshell report where Morales, the Republican secretary of state candidate, accused of sexually assaulting two women. Both women worked with Diego in Republican politics and came forward to share their stories last week. Since announcing his campaign for Indiana Secretary of State, Diego Morales:
* has been caught misleading Hoosiers about his background,
* has shady campaign finance practices,
* has called the last presidential election a “scam”, and
* has campaigned on an extreme platform that would cut Indiana’s early voting days in half.

_**On top of all of this, he was fired twice from the office he now seeks to lead. **_ Simply put: Diego Morales has more baggage than a baggage claim. He is unfit to hold any public office.
**\- Joe Biden Pardons Simple Possession Cannabis Convictions, INDems Call on Holcomb to Follow Suit -** Yesterday, President Joe Biden announced he would pardon thousands of Americans - potentially many Hoosiers - who were arrested for simple possession of marijuana. **** Additionally, Biden urged all governors to follow through with the same practice -- including Governor Eric Holcomb. Please see the state party’s statement following this announcement: _"About 80% of Hoosiers support cannabis legalization in some form, and a vote for Democrats is a vote to legalize this win-win policy in Indiana. Decriminalizing simple possession of marijuana is a game changer, because now Hoosiers with prior convictions will have access to a better quality of life -- including new job opportunities and a brighter future for their families. Democrats urge Governor Eric Holcomb to set aside his politics and follow the President's suit - like he's previously promised."**\- Indiana Democratic Party **_ INDems announced its support for legalized cannabis in 2021. **\- The Hoosier Promise - College Tour -** ** ** Next week, the INDems’ “Hoosier Promise - College Tour” will continue in Fort Wayne and West Lafayette. Candidates like Tom McDermott (Candidate for U.S. Senate), Jessica McClellan (Candidate for State Treasurer), ZeNai Brooks (Candidate for State Auditor), and Destiny Wells (Candidate for Secretary of State) will share with young voters how they will deliver on other top issues that are most important to them. This includes restoring a woman’s right to choose, legalizing cannabis, putting a stop to the state’s brain drain, providing housing that’s affordable for low-income or graduates, and passing additional gun safety legislation. Indiana’s youth will be the reason why Democrats will win on Election Day, and our candidates are ready to create a better future for them in the Hoosier State. See you there!

Team, the stories of women being denied vital health care since the Supreme Court’s Dobbs decision are infuriating and heartbreaking.

Team, the stories of women being denied vital health care since the Supreme Court’s Dobbs decision are infuriating and heartbreaking. Pregnant women with cancer being forced to delay treatment because it could harm their fetus. Women with miscarriages being denied abortions at grave risk to their health. A young girl having to travel across state lines in order to end a pregnancy that was the product of rape. **Let me be very, very clear about this: As your representative, I will work night and day to end the suffering caused by the overturning of Roe v. Wade and pass federal legislation reinstating the rights that the Supreme Court took away.** And I also need to be very clear about the differences here between me and my opponent: **In this race, I am up against an extremist Republican who applauded the overturning of Roe v. Wade — and who opposes the law I helped pass in Colorado that protects the right to choose in this state.** This seat is one of just a handful that will determine whether we have a pro-choice majority in Congress to protect the right to choose nationwide. We’re only up two points in the polls, and we’re being attacked every day by my anti-choice opponent and his dark-money allies. I don’t like having to ask for help, but the truth is we can’t win this race if we don’t fight back harder and compete for every vote, and I would hate for this to be the seat that costs Democrats a pro-choice House majority. **[If you’re with me, I would be humbled and grateful for your support. | | | Peter, you know I hate to be negative.

There's truly no one who believes in this campaign more than me, which is why it kills me to say I may have to __**[call it quits.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61546636:6JXV-FVhN:m:1:3331421248:3053D3DCAE1BC0409F871DF1BDEC124F:r "call it quits.")**__

My finance team just called me and delivered some devastating news... _**we 're about to come up $4,750 short of our goal.**_

---
| | [HELP MEET TIFFANY'S GOAL](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61546636:6JXV-FVhN:m:1:3331421248:3053D3DCAE1BC0409F871DF1BDEC124F:r "HELP MEET
TIFFANY’S GOAL")
---

Why is this such devastating news, you ask? Well, my opponent, Patty Murray, hit her goal DAYS ago and is already launching huge ad campaigns.

I'm genuinely overwhelmed by all of this. I don't see how we can catch up to an ever-growing and seemingly unbeatable war chest.

_**And to make matters worse, other Republican candidates are suffering the same fate and are closing up shop.**_

This couldn't be more severe and is why I'm asking - no begging - you to read every word of this email.

I'm a first-time candidate, veteran advocate, and political outsider. I've spent so much of my life raising my 3 incredible boys and caring for my husband when he was permanently blinded while serving in Iraq.

Unlike my opponent, I haven't spent the last 30 years building connections and raising money from political elites.

But that's precisely why I have a real chance of defeating her this November. I'm bringing the fresh ideas and leadership America needs, and the Democrats know it.

So I'll get right to it.

I need you on my team. I won't put a number on it because I mean it when I say anything you give can and will be a game-changer in this election.

We're creeping into the final hour of today's deadline, but I know that we'll keep this campaign going with your support.

_**[So what do you think? Will you be a part of my history-making campaign by chipping in what you can before tonight's deadline?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61546636:6JXV-FVhN:m:1:3331421248:3053D3DCAE1BC0409F871DF1BDEC124F:r "So what do you think? Will you be a part of my history-making campaign by chipping in what you can before
tonight’s deadline?")**_

I really hope you understand where I'm coming from.

I promise I wouldn't reach out like this if it weren't the end of the road.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

Democrats love to virtue signal non-stop, and cancel anyone who disagrees with them. For the longest time, it worked.

**But now, conservatives know the Left’s game, and how to beat it.** The key is to be PROUD of our beliefs, ignore the liberal attacks, and tell everyday working-class Americans what we believe -- and how our principles make their lives better.

Now, we’re seeing Republicans of all stripes filing to run for office, saying what’s on their mind, and defending our shared beliefs.

clean_body: Monica nearly made history, but 6,588 votes got in the way. Now, I'm asking for you to help my friend make it to the top of the hill this time around | Fellow patriot, Democrats love to virtue signal non-stop, and cancel anyone who disagrees with them. For the longest time, it worked. But now, conservatives know the Left’s game, and how to beat it. The key is to be PROUD of our beliefs, ignore the liberal attacks, and tell everyday working-class Americans what we believe -- and how our principles make their lives better. Now, we’re seeing Republicans of all stripes filing to run for office, saying what’s on their mind, and defending our shared beliefs. Let me be clear: The Republican Party welcomes anyone who shares our values. My friend Monica De La Cruz knows that, too. In 2020, Monica De La Cruz fell short just 6,588 votes from winning a seat in Congress that has been held by Democrats for over 100 years. Had she been successful, Monica would have been the first Hispanic Republican ever elected to Congress from South Texas. Will you please to help me end 120 years of Democrats holding the congressional seat she's currently running for? I encouraged Monica to try again – a 6,000 vote deficit is easily overcome with the right message and enough support. . Monica has set a personal goal of raising $15,000 before October 9th, and I’ve pledged to do all that I can to help her realize her goal. We need more people like Monica in Congress; she is living proof of the American Dream. She knows that in America, when you set your mind to something you can achieve it. She was raised by a single mother in a Texas border town, despite the hardships, Monica struck out on her own to realize her own American Dream. Armed with her faith and support from her Mother, Monica grew up to become one of the top insurance agents in South Texas. We need people like Monica in Congress. A woman who knows what hard work is; a woman who has the perseverance and grit to deliver for her community. Republicans only need to pick up FIVE seats next year to win back the House, and I can tell you that Monica’s race is one of the best chances we have at flipping a BLUE seat RED! On behalf of my friend Monica, – whatever that means to you. Monica will represent our entire Party in the House, and she’ll make us all proud. Peter,

Yesterday I sent you an email letting you know that the race is tightening up as we barrel toward Election Day. It was my hope that the news about Politico moving my race from “likely Democrat” to “lean Democrat” would get all of you excited.

**The response was tepid, to say the least.** **Just 10 supporters donated to my campaign all day yesterday.**

With just 32 days until Election Day, that is how we lose this race - and the House majority. Peter, **my opponent and her allies are spending more than $500,000 to attack me and slander my good name to the voters I’m asking to support me.**

With our race TIED this close to ballots going in the mail, **we cannot afford to lose your support now.**

Today, we need to double what we raised yesterday. Like a lot of people, I grew up going to church and had a relationship with God that wasn’t especially strong. But as I grew older that changed.

When I started my time at the United States Military Academy, two young men invited me to a Bible study.

They were very intentional to me in explaining God’s Word. After some study and discipleship with them, they helped me begin my walk with Christ.

**Since then, faith has been central to my life.** I keep a Bible open on my desk, and read every morning from the Good Book.

subject: I just walked off the debate stage
body:
Mandela Barnes here.
I just walked off the debate stage, and I hope you’ll give me a moment to explain what tonight meant and why I need you to make a contribution before midnight. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20221007_CGVA_Barnes]
I believe in abortion rights and the right of everyone to make decisions about their own body.
I believe in taking on special interests that have too much power over our political process and our economy.
I believe in rebuilding the middle class and guaranteeing all people have the opportunity to thrive, regardless of where they live or how much money they make.
Ron Johnson has co-sponsored eight national abortion bans, including a ban with no exceptions for rape or incest. And he is an out-of-touch multi-millionaire who has used his time in office to enrich himself and his billionaire donors.
He's also the most vulnerable Republican Senator up for re-election this year.
While Ron Johnson is counting on his billionaire-funded super PACs to win this race, I am counting on you. We've received more than 500,000 online donations so far, and that support means the world to me.
But this Wisconsin Senate race requires more.
Ron Johnson and Republican dark-money groups are flooding Wisconsin with millions of dollars in attack ads. They're outspending us by 2 to 1 some weeks, and we can't risk losing any more ground in this race.
So please, I am respectfully asking:
Can I count on you to use this link to split a contribution of $25, or whatever you can afford, between our campaign to defeat Ron Johnson and CommonGood so we can flip Wisconsin's Senate seat? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_barnes?refcode=20221007_CGVA_Barnes]

name: Cori Bush
subject: Be a part of this
body:
I'm reaching out for your help.
#
Peter,
We announced something I'm really proud of: **we're taking our fight for reproductive freedom on the road from October 8-10.**
In the hours after _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned, Missouri became the first state to ban abortion. So, we're joining with key partners for a statewide tour to rally and spread the message that our reproductive rights are not up for debate.
[**In order to make this tour possible, we need your support to fund travel, outreach, and logistics. Can you help power our Roe The Vote: Reproductive Freedom Tour by splitting a donation between Justice Democrats and our campaign today?**](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/117070?refcode=em20221007-25455&t=1&akid=25455%2E1203867%2ElziOAy)

This issue is not theoretical to me. And as a nurse, mother, pastor, and activist, I know this is not a fight Democrats can give up on.
It's why I became one of the first sitting members of Congress to tell my story publicly in a House Oversight Committee hearing. body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter — yesterday, President Biden pardoned thousands of people
who were convicted of ‘simple possession' of marijuana.

This is a massive development from President Biden, and although it's a
great first step, I plan to go even further.

We must end the war on drugs and legalize cannabis. Legalizing cannabis is
about more than just allowing recreational use, potential medicinal
benefits, or the money that can be made from this new market.

It’s about overturning a century's worth of racist legislation that
disproportionately affects Black and Brown Kentuckians. It’s about
decriminalizing poverty and rebuilding the communities that have suffered
the most harm. And it’s about ensuring that everyone has access to the
opportunities that the new cannabis market provides.

It makes no sense to lock up Kentuckians for possessing less than an ounce
of marijuana while millionaires profit tremendously from its legal sale.

It’s not fair and it’s certainly not justice. The injustice must end and I
plan to do just that. Send me to the Senate and let's finally legalize
cannabis.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18726?t=1001&akid=2563%2E346206%2E3ZE53Q ]I’m ready to tackle this crisis head-on, but it’s going to take a
grassroots movement. Make a $20 donation today to support this plan and be
in this fight with me.
