clean_body: [1]Charles Booker Peter — yesterday, President Biden pardoned thousands of people who were convicted of ‘simple possession' of marijuana. This is a massive development from President Biden, and although it's a great first step, I plan to go even further. We must end the war on drugs and legalize cannabis. Legalizing cannabis is about more than just allowing recreational use, potential medicinal benefits, or the money that can be made from this new market. It’s about overturning a century's worth of racist legislation that disproportionately affects Black and Brown Kentuckians. It’s about decriminalizing poverty and rebuilding the communities that have suffered the most harm. And it’s about ensuring that everyone has access to the opportunities that the new cannabis market provides. It makes no sense to lock up Kentuckians for possessing less than an ounce of marijuana while millionaires profit tremendously from its legal sale. It’s not fair and it’s certainly not justice. The injustice must end and I plan to do just that. Send me to the Senate and let's finally legalize cannabis. [ ]I’m ready to tackle this crisis head-on, but it’s going to take a grassroots movement. clean_body: We cannot afford to wait until Election Day to reach these voters – we must secure their votes TODAY. | Fellow American, This is an emergency, and I don’t have much time. My team on the ground just called with the news: this race is a total toss-up. The winner will come down to just a few hundred undecided voters... just like in 2020 when I lost by less than 2%. The Democratic National Committee is investing hundreds of thousands of dollars into my opponent’s advertising budget to smear my name and trick swing voters into thinking she is moderate. News flash: she is not. She is merely a mouthpiece for Joe Biden and Nancy Pelosi. We have to reach the final swing voters if we want to win this election, but that means we need to buy up the remaining TV slots before Craig does. It’ll take $50,000 to pay the TV stations. Fellow American, we cannot afford to wait until Election Day to reach these voters – we must secure their votes TODAY. Keep in mind, this is the race that will determine who wins the House majority and we cannot leave anything up to chance. The future of our country is at stake, I would hate to come so close to victory and fall short again, Fellow American. I cannot win without you. In service, Tyler Kistner Father. Husband. Marine. | | **2022 October e-newsletter**
**All county cities on track to become ‘Age Friendly’ **
Dear friends, I want to offer a special thanks to all in our community who have participated on the county’s journey to have all of our cities designated “Age-Friendly” communities by the World Health Organization. We are now in the fifth year of this endeavor and it’s been a privilege to see the partnership between the county and the Center for Age Friendly Excellence to help our cities become age-friendly certified. Five years ago, this journey started with Redwood City, Daly City and Pacifica in a pilot program that has now spread across the entire county. Currently 12 cities are certified with Atherton, East Palo Alto, Menlo Park, Portola Valley and South San Francisco headed toward certification in 2023. Just recently both Millbrae and Belmont received the certification from WHO. Special thanks to Anabel Pelham at CAFÉ for many years of service to the county on helping us reach this milestone, which we celebrated at a summit at Skyline College in September. Former state Senator Jerry Hill acted as master of ceremonies and guided representatives from each city who shared community organizing process of focus group research, project development and plans for the future. Keynote speaker Sutep Laohavanich, Deputy Director of the California Department of Aging, outlined an update of the state’s Master Plan on Aging and I had the honor to share the history, vision and importance of the age-friendly cities initiative as a vital public policy for the demographic changes in California. As many of you know our county is rapidly aging. By 2030, it is estimated that 30 percent of the county’s population will be over the age of 65. San Mateo County has been committed to supporting older adults as they take charge of their health, explore new opportunities and activities and focus on independence, especially during the pandemic. We are transforming San Mateo County forever into a caring community that encourages people of all ages to live active lives and I hope we can continue to strive toward that goal. I’d like to share a quote from George Bernard Shaw who said: “We don’t stop playing because we grow old. We grow old because we stop playing.” To learn more go to: [http://cfafe.org/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=7af87d6efd&e=c0babbc643) **New bivalent booster recommended for everyone 12+** With new Omicron variants of COVID-19 spreading through the community, it is recommended for everyone 12 and older to get the new bivalent booster, which replaces previous booster recommendations. But according to our county Health System, only 6 percent or 43,429 county residents have received the updated COVID-19 booster. With that in mind, the county is offering the updated booster at clinics throughout the county and I encourage you all to take that shot to keep your family protected from this still circulating disease. A list of clinics and schedules can be found here [https://www.smchealth.org/vaccine-clinic-calendar](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=a081caa4ff&e=c0babbc643) and no appointments are necessary. Broader health care systems – primary care practices and pharmacies across the county – are also offering the updated booster. At many pharmacy locations, you can make an appointment same day or next day, and at some locations flu shots can be obtained during the same visit. The updated COVID-19 boosters are currently available for those ages 12 and older, and we anticipate that these updated boosters will be available later this month for children ages 5 to 11, according to the county’s Health System.. The county will continue to offer weekly standing COVID-19 vaccine clinics in East Palo Alto, North Fair Oaks, San Mateo, Half Moon Bay, South San Francisco, and Daly City through the end of October. **New mural highlights benefits of public art**

I was proud to join Jefferson High School’s GrizzArt Club as it celebrated the completion of its first mural with a ribbon-cutting ceremony last month at Daly City Mitsubishi at the intersection of Mission Street and Hillside Boulevard.

The recently-completed mural is the result of a collaboration between Victoria Magbilang, project funder Dragonfly Community Arts, and the Bay Area Mural Program (BAMP), who worked with the GrizzArt students and their advisor Suzanne Koehnlein to design and paint this exciting new Daly City landmark. This new 2,000-square-foot mural was created and envisioned by art club students at Jefferson High School in Daly City that imitates a vintage postcard and celebrates life in Daly City, showcasing foggy, hillside neighborhoods and iconic Daly City locations and imagery.

The ambitious project was a partnership between Dragonfly Community Arts, Bay Area Mural Program (BAMP), Jefferson High School, and Daly City leaders and community members. The project got its start in the Fall of 2021, when Dragonfly Community Arts connected with Victoria Magbilang, executive director of the Daly City Public Library Associates and current San Mateo County Arts Commissioner, about the need for public art in Daly City. The idea was to not only find a way to bring public art to the city, but to also educate and inspire young artists. Dragonfly looked no further than Jefferson High School and Bay Area Mural Program. The art club at Jefferson is student-led and meets weekly after school to explore new art opportunities and for students to learn from each other and explore their creativity. The mural is awesome and I encourage everyone to check it out. Our community needs more partnerships like this to expand public art.
**County budget reflects values of ending homelessness, offering assistance to those in need during pandemic** The San Mateo County Board of Supervisors approved a $4.2 billion revised budget for fiscal year 2022-23 last month that focuses on ending homelessness, continuing economic recovery from the pandemic and advancing social justice and equity. The revised budget calls for an increase of $791.2 million over the recommended budget the Board considered in June. The increase is fueled in large part by unanticipated growth in property taxes, particularly in the commercial sector, and sales taxes, along with the infusion of federal and state funds to assist with COVID-19 recovery. With a 20 percent increase in homelessness since the pandemic started, this Board has made historic investments to house and support our most vulnerable residents. The goal to reach functional zero homelessness is becoming within reach and this budget reflects the Board’s values to make sure that no one is left behind. The budget also includes increased support for food assistance, rental assistance and basic needs as inflation is having a huge impact on the working poor. Food prices are up nearly 11 percent and gas prices are up by 36 percent and we are seeing more and more people relying on credit to survive and many of had to dip into whatever meager savings they might have. I am proud that this budget includes increased support for food assistance, rental assistance, and basic needs. However, we must be prepared to offer additional relief to some in our community if the impacts of inflation continue. To see the budget go here: [https://www.smcgov.org/ceo/budget-publications](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=4562488c71&e=c0babbc643) **Battling food insecurity **
Food insecurity is a problem some residents may still face as we continue to emerge from the pandemic. Here are some resources residents can access: **CalFresh:**
Is a program for people with low-income who meet federal income eligibility rules and want to add to their budget to put healthy and nutritious food on the table. Website: [https://www.cdss.ca.gov/food-nutrition/calfresh](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=2438958b00&e=c0babbc643) Contact: (650) 802-6576, [antorres@smcgov.org](mailto:antorres@smcgov.org) **Daly City Partnership:**
DC Partnership is a local partnership that was formed to guide collaborative efforts and connect our community to services that promote well-being. Check out their website for times and locations. Website: [https://www.dcpartnership.org/covid19/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=cdc053cb75&e=c0babbc643) **Second Harvest Food Bank:**
Second Harvest offers food at various locations throughout San Mateo County listed on its webpage. Website: [https://www.shfb.org/get-food/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=b0f39dc14f&e=c0babbc643) Contacts: Call (800) 984-3663 or text GETFOOD to (408) 455-5181 **Interns wanted to join our team **

We are looking to add to our great group of interns we are currently working with. If you or someone you know may be interested in applying to my Internship Program, submitting this form is the first step: https://forms.gle/hiKqtn7Rird5vXwB9. You can also reach out to Mike Richardson on my staff directly with any questions at mrichardson@smcgov.org In friendship, David J. Canepa

**That's why this news is so exciting: A ****generous group of donors is _double-matching every single donation_ up to our $250,000 goal to make sure I have the resources to pull ahead and WIN. **

[Will you please rush a $5 donation now, which will have TWICE THE IMPACT? The truth is, we cannot take the lead, flip Florida blue and expand our Democratic Senate majority if we don't maximize this rare match opportunity.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52181299/371482865/1022809660?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4683-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MDg3YWYzMi04NzQ2LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fXNPDEf6HBUnvaj5x_fucZ4tjY58aRFH_JS-JfM-vK4=)

Rubio has already launched attack ads against me, and national Republicans – including Mitch McConnell himself – have over $76 million at their disposal to pour into more attacks against me. **That's why it's so important that we hit every single fundraising goal right now, because falling short and continuing to be outspent is too much of a risk and puts our odds of winning in serious danger. **

And the truth is, if we don’t have the resources we need to win this race, he might get his wish. Millions of dollars have already been spent trying to defeat us, and millions more are coming. If Trump can help flip this seat, he’ll be that much more likely to run in 2024. He might even win.

Sorry to put that thought in your head, but it’s true.

That’s why I need to know if you can split a $25 contribution between my campaign and the Democratic Party of Georgia before Trump arrives. Because when he does, a lot of people from the far right are going to look more closely at this race and pour money into Arizona to try to beat me.

name: Team AOC
subject: Rest in power, Mahsa and Nika
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Our struggles are connected.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20221007-3478-header&t=1&akid=3478%2E2526796%2EGgTrXC)
Iran is currently several weeks into mass protests after a young woman from Saqqez, Mahsa Amini, was killed after being taken into custody by the Morality Police in Tehran for the way she wore her hjiab.1
**And it has just been reported that the body of another young Iranian woman, Nika Shahkarami, was found in a Tehran morgue 10 days after she was allegedly chased by security forces at a demonstration and arrested. Before her family could bury her, her body was seized and interred by authorities 25 miles from her hometown.** 2
Protests have broken out all over Iran with demonstrators calling for the dismantling of the Morality Police, as well as women burning their hijabs in the street. Rights groups report thousands have been arrested and hundreds injured, mostly due to authorities using tear gas and openly firing metal pellets and even live bullets on crowds. These groups estimate the death toll is currently over 150.3
**Make no mistake, Mahsa and Nika were senselessly murdered for challenging patriarchal and autocratic systems of control.**
From the United States to Latin America, Iran, and across the world, women and allies are rising up to confront and resist state systems of misogyny and abuses of power. **Bodily autonomy is about our essential right to make decisions about our own bodies, from hijabs to abortion. Our struggles are connected**.
Be sure to check in on your Iranian brothers and sisters during this disturbing time. The future we are building is for all of us.
In solidarity,
Team AOC
P.S. [**You can learn more about the tragedy here.**](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14952?t=2&akid=3478%2E2526796%2EGgTrXC)

clean_body: Our struggles are connected. Iran is currently several weeks into mass protests after a young woman from Saqqez, Mahsa Amini, was killed after being taken into custody by the Morality Police in Tehran for the way she wore her hjiab.1 And it has just been reported that the body of another young Iranian woman, Nika Shahkarami, was found in a Tehran morgue 10 days after she was allegedly chased by security forces at a demonstration and arrested. Before her family could bury her, her body was seized and interred by authorities 25 miles from her hometown. 2 Protests have broken out all over Iran with demonstrators calling for the dismantling of the Morality Police, as well as women burning their hijabs in the street. Rights groups report thousands have been arrested and hundreds injured, mostly due to authorities using tear gas and openly firing metal pellets and even live bullets on crowds. These groups estimate the death toll is currently over 150.3 Make no mistake, Mahsa and Nika were senselessly murdered for challenging patriarchal and autocratic systems of control. From the United States to Latin America, Iran, and across the world, women and allies are rising up to confront and resist state systems of misogyny and abuses of power. Bodily autonomy is about our essential right to make decisions about our own bodies, from hijabs to abortion. Our struggles are connected. Be sure to check in on your Iranian brothers and sisters during this disturbing time. The future we are building is for all of us. body:
Two of the most consequential elections in the country are happening in Alaska in just 32 days | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/ce8bb9dba113/introducing-new-action-fund-help-create-positive-change-6111643?e=110fec2088)

Hi , it’s Al Gross — former candidate for U.S. Senate and House and a lifelong Alaskan. I’m reaching out on behalf of Build Alaska’s Future Action Fund to say this:**Two of the most consequential elections in the country are happening in Alaska in just 32 days** : U.S. Rep. Mary Peltola’s race for Congress and Senator Lisa Murkowski’s race for Senate.[**Will you donate $25 to help us reach our goal of raising $10,000 by midnight tonight to help elect Mary Peltola and Lisa Murkowski?**](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=06d131b2d7&e=110fec2088) Recent polling has shown **Sen. Lisa Murkowksi is virtually tied with her extremist opponent Kelly Tshibaka in the race for Senate.** Sen. Murkowksi has been a tireless advocate for federal funding for Alaska, and is one of only two Senate Republicans who support abortion rights. **She is a vital bipartisan voice who puts people over party, and we cannot afford to lose her in the Senate.** Mary Peltola is the first Democrat Alaska has elected to Congress in over 50 years, and her opponent, **Sarah Palin, is a major opponent of choice and the infrastructure funding Joe Biden and Democrats have secured for Alaska.****We cannot elect extremists who will put their radical partisanship ahead of the future of Alaska.** Our organization fights to ensure that Alaskans receive our share of the federal funding, and electing Lisa Murkowski and Mary Peltola is an essential part of that.[**If you’re ready to support our mission, will you make a donation of $25 so we can reach our one-day $10,000 fundraising goal?**](https://buildak.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a7fb3ecc9b75994da1a2bfe7b&id=535cf651dd&e=110fec2088)

Thank you,Al Gross

Team,
Elissa's final debate with her opponent aired last night on Channel 6 in Lansing. This debate made clear her opponent’s position on a number of key issues and foreshadowed how he would vote on those issues as a member of Congress.
You can click below to read a full recap from the Detroit News.
https://www.detroitnews.com/story/news/politics/michigan/2022/10/07/slotkin-barrett-spar-in-second-final-debate/69545606007/ [https://www.detroitnews.com/story/news/politics/michigan/2022/10/07/slotkin-barrett-spar-in-second-final-debate/69545606007/]
The most remarkable moment of the night was Elissa’s opponent’s admission that he continues to oppose gay marriage. When asked if he accepted gay marriage, he said “I’m not someone who favors that.” He went on to say that he supported the 2004 Michigan ballot measure that banned gay marriage in the state. He voiced opposition to the Supreme Court’s decision in Obergefell v. Hodges, the ruling that legalized gay marriage across the country.
Ultimately, the theme of this final debate is that Elissa’s opponent is looking to turn back the clock for Michiganders – chip in below to help us make sure that doesn’t happen. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221007&amount=28]

| Friends,

This Sunday, Donald Trump is coming back to Arizona and my opponent will be right on stage with him. Trump knows how important this state is, and how important our race is.

That’s why at one of his previous rallies here, he said: “Taking America back begins with kicking Mark Kelly the hell out of the United States Senate.”

And the truth is, if we don’t have the resources we need to win this race, he might get his wish. Millions of dollars have already been spent trying to defeat us, and millions more are coming. If Trump can help flip this seat, he’ll be that much more likely to run in 2024. He might even win.

Sorry to put that thought in your head, but it’s true.

That’s why I need to know if you can make a contribution before Trump arrives. Because when he does, a lot of people from the far right are going to look more closely at this race and pour money into Arizona to try to beat me.

So, I’m humbly asking:

**[Can you please split a contribution between our campaign and the Arizona Democratic Party to help us defend this seat? It all adds up when everyone is chipping in. Friend, I am feeling _fired up,_ and I hope you are, too. **With exactly 32 days left to win Georgia's Senate race, we're gearing up to make each and every one of those days count out on the campaign trail:**
| | | | I'm hitting the road to meet with voters in every corner of the state. |
---|---|---|---
| | | | I'm taking the stage to finally debate Herschel Walker on the issues that matter to everyday Georgians (something he spent months avoiding at all costs). |
---|---|---|---
| | | | We'll be out knocking on as many doors as we possibly can across Georgia. |
---|---|---|---
| | | | We're launching TV ads to spread our people-powered message far and wide. |
---|---|---|---
| | | | And we're 100% focused on mobilizing every single voter to help us reach our goal come Election Day. |
---|---|---|---

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. body:
Giroux helped end background checks for guns
| | | | |

| | | | | Peter, in a moment, I'm going to ask you to join me in helping Rachel Baker defeat Jenn Giroux, in what is Ohio's most important state legislative race--perhaps one of the most important in the country. **_Four years ago, my daughter Jaime was murdered with an assault weapon in the Parkland massacre. Ever since, Republicans like Jenn Giroux have not only done almost nothing to solve a problem, but, in fact, they've passed legislation in Ohio and other states to allow any criminal or terrorist to carry concealed weapons of war in our streets, by eliminating background checks._** We've seen the results in Uvalde, Buffalo, Highland Park, and in 2019, the Oregon, District of Dayton, Ohio, when nine people out for a fun night on the town were murdered, and 17 others sent to local hospitals with their lives never to be the same. [**This is about saving lives: Will you donate $5, $10, $25 or whatever you can afford to elect Rachel Baker, defeat Jenn Giroux and put us closer to expanding gun safety and abortion rights in Ohio and nationally?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta7e8c9e8-e2ed-4ee5-aba9-9af1a4a41509/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **After the awful Supreme Court decision overturning Roe v Wade, Giroux also came out against abortion in all cases--making the ridiculous claim that women never have to choose between their lives and having an abortion. Giroux's combination of extremism and ignorance are both astounding and dangerous. **
---
|
---
| | | | | | [**GIVE NOW >>**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1a4d54db-bd5c-42fe-9781-6301aab667be/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| **Luckily, we have a fierce gun safety advocate and former Planned Parenthood employee in Rachel Baker running against her. And why is this so important? Because this district is listed as the most swing seat in Ohio, and if Rachel and four other Democrats win in slightly more Democratic districts, the Republican-gerrymandered supermajority in the state house will end. ** This is crucial, as Nan Whaley has a good chance of being Ohio's next Governor. even if the worst happens and Mike DeWine is reelected, on the few of things where DeWine isn't as crazy as the gerrymandered state house, they won't be able to override his veto. It is also key to getting closer to taking back the state house under the newer lines prescribed by a constitutional amendment to the state constitution. So I'm asking for your help, friend. Jenn Giroux is being supported by the worst right-wing mega-donors and interests spending a ton of money on her behalf. If we can help Rachel Baker overcome the right-wing money and win this race, we'll also helping turn out voters to help elect Whaley, and Democrats Greg Landsman in a swing House seat and Tim Ryan as our U.S. Senator. **_I've often said I consider Ohio a second home, as much of my family lives in the Cincinnati area. But, also, America is my home, and this race will have ripple effects across the country._** [**Please, friend, this is about saving lives: Will you donate $5, $10, $25 or whatever you can afford to elect Rachel Baker, defeat Jenn Giroux and put us closer to expanding gun safety and abortion rights in Ohio and nationally?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T515a6750-f220-453f-942b-9021220b5e1c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

body:

_**Important Message from mom and parents rights activist, Jessi Melton**_

Hello Peter,

Would you believe me if I told you that two middle-school teachers manipulated a student into changing her gender?

_Because that 's exactly what happened in Spreckels, California._

Mother Jessica Konen has filed a legal case against her school district. She believes teachers Lori Caldeira and Kelly Baraki convinced her sixth-grade daughter she was bisexual and then introduced the idea she was transgender.
